meta.setting: Warhammer 40,000 (9th edition core, Rogue Trader, Wrath & Glory, Imperium Maledictum)
meta.licence: commercial (Games Workshop; Fantasy Flight Games and Cubicle 7 under licence); design reference only
meta.pass: PWC37, book tier, gpt-6-luna reader, unchecked against a second reader
meta.split: tuned when sha1("settings-v1:"+id) first byte < 0x40, else held-out (GKM429)

warhammer-40k.power.psychic-potential.name: psychic potential

effect.summary: Allows psykers to reshape reality using warp energy.

warhammer-40k.power.psychic-potential.cost_or_limit: Requires psychic potential and warp energy.
warhammer-40k.power.psychic-potential.go_wrong: Warp use can bring storms, mutation, and daemonic danger.
warhammer-40k.power.psychic-potential.blocked_reason: Reality alteration is covered by the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.power.astropathic-communic.name: Astropathic Communication

effect.summary: Communicates across space between Astropaths by projecting and interpreting images in their minds.

warhammer-40k.power.astropathic-communic.cost_or_limit: Requires an Astropath and communication across the Warp.
warhammer-40k.power.astropathic-communic.go_wrong: The Warp is described as tumultuous; no specific mishap stated.
warhammer-40k.power.astropathic-communic.mind: Projects images into another Astropath’s mind.
warhammer-40k.power.astropathic-communic.combines: Other Astropaths receive and interpret the message.

warhammer-40k.power.conjure-blasts-of-fi.name: conjure blasts of fire

effect.summary: A psyker produces fire blasts.

warhammer-40k.power.conjure-blasts-of-fi.go_wrong: Uncontrolled manifestations may occur when the psyker is frightened or angry; daemons may be drawn to the psyker.
warhammer-40k.power.conjure-blasts-of-fi.where_from: Warp energies channelled through the mind
warhammer-40k.power.conjure-blasts-of-fi.blocked_reason: The passage does not specify the blast's range or precise mechanical effect.

warhammer-40k.power.glean-glimpses-of-th.name: glean glimpses of the future

effect.summary: A psyker obtains glimpses of future events.

warhammer-40k.power.glean-glimpses-of-th.go_wrong: Uncontrolled manifestations may occur when the psyker is frightened or angry; daemons may be drawn to the psyker.
warhammer-40k.power.glean-glimpses-of-th.where_from: Warp energies channelled through the mind
warhammer-40k.power.glean-glimpses-of-th.blocked_reason: Seeing future events requires divination, which the basic effect grammar cannot represent.

warhammer-40k.power.alter-their-physical.name: alter their physical appearance

effect.summary: A psyker changes their appearance.

warhammer-40k.power.alter-their-physical.go_wrong: Uncontrolled manifestations may occur when the psyker is frightened or angry; daemons may be drawn to the psyker.
warhammer-40k.power.alter-their-physical.where_from: Warp energies channelled through the mind
warhammer-40k.power.alter-their-physical.blocked_reason: Changing a living body's appearance requires a form-transformation capability.

warhammer-40k.power.transform-hapless-vi.name: transform hapless victims to bloody ruin

effect.summary: A psyker can devastate victims with a thought.

warhammer-40k.power.transform-hapless-vi.go_wrong: Uncontrolled manifestations may occur when the psyker is frightened or angry; daemons may be drawn to the psyker.
warhammer-40k.power.transform-hapless-vi.where_from: Warp energies channelled through the mind
warhammer-40k.power.transform-hapless-vi.blocked_reason: The description entails a destructive bodily transformation beyond the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.power.read-and-influence-t.name: read and influence the minds of others

effect.summary: A psyker reads and influences other minds.

warhammer-40k.power.read-and-influence-t.go_wrong: Uncontrolled manifestations may occur when the psyker is frightened or angry; daemons may be drawn to the psyker.
warhammer-40k.power.read-and-influence-t.mind: Can manipulate other people and control them as puppets.
warhammer-40k.power.read-and-influence-t.where_from: Warp energies channelled through the mind
warhammer-40k.power.read-and-influence-t.blocked_reason: Influencing and puppeteering minds requires a mind-binding capability.

warhammer-40k.power.soul-binding-ritual.name: soul-binding ritual

effect.summary: A ritual binds a psyker's soul and makes them safer for Imperial service.

warhammer-40k.power.soul-binding-ritual.blocked_reason: Binding a soul is not represented by the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.power.waaagh.name: Waaagh!

effect.summary: A critical mass of Orks begins a devastating campaign of warfare.

warhammer-40k.power.waaagh.cost_or_limit: Arises when Ork numbers reach critical mass.
warhammer-40k.power.waaagh.go_wrong: Can bring the Imperium close to collapse.
warhammer-40k.power.waaagh.blocked_reason: The phenomenon describes a broad regional war, not a single basic effect.

warhammer-40k.power.fire-break.name: fire break

effect.summary: Imperial forces destroyed a belt of worlds to deny them to the T'au advance.

warhammer-40k.power.fire-break.combines: Used to end the Damocles conflict.
warhammer-40k.power.fire-break.blocked_reason: The effect destroys multiple worlds across a broad frontage.

warhammer-40k.power.hive-mind.name: Hive Mind

effect.summary: The Genestealer gains +1 Resolve while connected to the Tyranid Hive Mind.

warhammer-40k.power.hive-mind.cost_or_limit: Requires a connection to the Hive Mind.
warhammer-40k.power.hive-mind.blocked_reason: A conditional Resolve bonus is representable as a basic modifier.

warhammer-40k.power.stasis-field.name: stasis field

effect.summary: A field preserved Guilliman in a long sleep through the millennia.

warhammer-40k.power.stasis-field.combines: Used to preserve Guilliman until his later healing.
warhammer-40k.power.stasis-field.blocked_reason: Suspending a subject across millennia requires temporal stasis beyond the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.power.psychic-talent.name: psychic talent

effect.summary: Asuryani psychic sensitivity registers growing warp energy.

warhammer-40k.power.psychic-talent.cost_or_limit: Asuryani possess only a small measure of it, though it can sharpen.
warhammer-40k.power.psychic-talent.go_wrong: The rising psychic energy is dangerous.
warhammer-40k.power.psychic-talent.who_may: Asuryani are described as possessing it.
warhammer-40k.power.psychic-talent.where_from: Psychic nature; its increase follows the Great Rift's opening.
warhammer-40k.power.psychic-talent.combines: Its heightened sensitivity helps detect the swelling psychic energy.

warhammer-40k.power.the-flaw.name: the Flaw

effect.summary: Causes Blood Angels to descend into a berserk blood-frenzy.

warhammer-40k.power.the-flaw.cost_or_limit: Associated with Blood Angels and their successors.
warhammer-40k.power.the-flaw.go_wrong: The frenzy can be irreversible and ruinous.
warhammer-40k.power.the-flaw.blocked_reason: A potentially irreversible mental-state curse is beyond the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.power.genetic-alchemy.name: genetic alchemy

effect.summary: Creates Custodians with exceptional vitality, strength, resilience, speed and intellect.

warhammer-40k.power.genetic-alchemy.cost_or_limit: The process is a closely guarded secret.
warhammer-40k.power.genetic-alchemy.mind: Produces exceptional intellect; no other mental change stated.
warhammer-40k.power.genetic-alchemy.blocked_reason: The process permanently transforms a person’s body and capabilities.

warhammer-40k.power.motive-force.name: Motive Force

effect.summary: It is said to spiritually manifest the Omnissiah and inhabit technology as Machine Spirits.

warhammer-40k.power.motive-force.combines: Manifested as Machine Spirits in technology
warhammer-40k.power.motive-force.blocked_reason: The passage describes a spiritual presence but gives no runnable effect.

effect.summary: Moves super-heavy war engines directly into battle.

warhammer-40k.power.mind-wiped.name: mind wiped

effect.summary: Erases memories from affected Imperial forces.

warhammer-40k.power.mind-wiped.combines: Used to conceal knowledge of the warp threat

warhammer-40k.power.daemonhood.name: Daemonhood

effect.summary: A favoured champion may become an immortal daemon.

warhammer-40k.power.daemonhood.cost_or_limit: A rare reward for serving Chaos; attainment is dangerous and uncertain.
warhammer-40k.power.daemonhood.go_wrong: Blessings may cause uncontrolled mutation or mental collapse.
warhammer-40k.power.daemonhood.combines: Rituals, slaughter, and service to a patron
warhammer-40k.power.daemonhood.blocked_reason: Changing a champion into an immortal daemon requires a major form transformation.

warhammer-40k.power.semi-autonomous-tent.name: semi-autonomous tentacles

effect.summary: A champion may be granted independently acting tentacles.

warhammer-40k.power.semi-autonomous-tent.go_wrong: Excessive blessings can cause uncontrolled mutation.
warhammer-40k.power.semi-autonomous-tent.blocked_reason: Creating new semi-autonomous body parts is a bodily transformation.

effect.summary: Enables Death Guard warriors to endure attacks that would destroy others.
Pain does not trouble Death Guard warriors.
Chaos throngs cast searing warp fire during battle.

warhammer-40k.power.psychic-powers.name: Psychic Powers

effect.summary: Grants access to Telepathic Discipline techniques, including Astral Telepathy and two chosen techniques.

warhammer-40k.power.psychic-powers.mind: Telepathic techniques are available; their effects are not specified here
warhammer-40k.power.psychic-powers.combines: Includes Astral Telepathy and two additional selected techniques
warhammer-40k.power.psychic-powers.blocked_reason: The passage grants access to powers but does not describe the effects of the techniques.

warhammer-40k.power.path-system.name: Path system

effect.summary: Aeldari dedicate periods of life to one discipline before moving to another, preventing excess.

warhammer-40k.power.path-system.cost_or_limit: A single discipline is followed for a portion of life.
warhammer-40k.power.path-system.go_wrong: Without it, Aeldari are vulnerable to excess.
warhammer-40k.power.path-system.mind: Constrains focus and helps resist excess.
warhammer-40k.power.path-system.blocked_reason: The system manages a psychological tendency toward excess beyond a simple effect.

warhammer-40k.power.path-of-the-warrior.name: Path of the Warrior

effect.summary: A follower trains in a martial aspect and may join a temple of Khaine.

warhammer-40k.power.path-of-the-warrior.cost_or_limit: It is one focused life discipline.
warhammer-40k.power.path-of-the-warrior.mind: Has an irresistible lure for many Asuryani.

warhammer-40k.power.revivify.name: revivify

effect.summary: Haemonculi can restore even a brutally slain Drukhari to life.

warhammer-40k.power.revivify.cost_or_limit: Haemonculi knowledge and facilities are required.
warhammer-40k.power.revivify.blocked_reason: Restoring a slain person requires resolving their soul and death state.

warhammer-40k.power.mont-ka.name: Mont'ka

effect.summary: The Killing Blow, a military strategy studied by the Fire caste.

warhammer-40k.power.mont-ka.cost_or_limit: Use depends on the battlefield situation.
warhammer-40k.power.mont-ka.combines: One of two strategic philosophies, alongside Kauyon.
warhammer-40k.power.mont-ka.blocked_reason: It is a strategy rather than a supernatural effect.

warhammer-40k.power.kauyon.name: Kauyon

effect.summary: The Patient Hunter, a military strategy studied by the Fire caste.

warhammer-40k.power.kauyon.cost_or_limit: Use depends on the battlefield situation.
warhammer-40k.power.kauyon.combines: One of two strategic philosophies, alongside Mont'ka.
warhammer-40k.power.kauyon.blocked_reason: It is a strategy rather than a supernatural effect.

warhammer-40k.power.shadow-in-the-warp.name: Shadow in the Warp

effect.summary: A psychic signal silences a world and prevents warp travel and communication.

warhammer-40k.power.shadow-in-the-warp.cost_or_limit: Occurs as Tyranid hive fleets approach a prey world.
warhammer-40k.power.shadow-in-the-warp.go_wrong: Leaves populations unable to escape or request help.
warhammer-40k.power.shadow-in-the-warp.mechanism: area-wide psychic communications and travel suppression
warhammer-40k.power.shadow-in-the-warp.blocked_reason: It suppresses communications and warp travel across an entire world.

warhammer-40k.power.smite.name: Smite

effect.summary: Inflicts mortal wounds on the nearest visible enemy unit within 18 inches; a high test result increases the damage.

warhammer-40k.power.smite.cost_or_limit: Warp charge increases by 1 for each earlier attempt to manifest Smite by the same army that phase.
warhammer-40k.power.smite.go_wrong: A double 1 or double 6 on the Psychic test causes Perils of the Warp; the psyker takes mortal wounds and may harm nearby units if destroyed.
warhammer-40k.power.smite.combines: Can be denied by an opposing psyker; unlike other psychic powers, it may be attempted more than once per battle round.
warhammer-40k.power.smite.mechanism: Psychic test against warp charge, followed by an opposed denial test.
warhammer-40k.power.smite.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar does not express mortal-wound damage or its dice-based amount.

warhammer-40k.power.objective-secured.name: Objective Secured

effect.summary: Lets its player control an objective marker when their models with the ability are in range and no enemy models with it are in range.

warhammer-40k.power.objective-secured.cost_or_limit: Requires friendly models with the ability in range and no enemy models with it in range.
warhammer-40k.power.objective-secured.combines: Contested by enemy models with the same ability in range.
warhammer-40k.power.objective-secured.blocked_reason: The stated effect can be represented as a conditional control relation.

warhammer-40k.power.inspiring-leader.name: Inspiring Leader

effect.summary: Adds 1 to the Leadership characteristic of friendly units near the Warlord.

warhammer-40k.power.inspiring-leader.cost_or_limit: Applies to friendly units within 6 inches.
warhammer-40k.power.inspiring-leader.who_may: Any Warlord can have this trait.
warhammer-40k.power.inspiring-leader.blocked_reason: The characteristic bonus can be represented as an alteration.

warhammer-40k.power.command-re-roll.name: Command Re-roll

effect.summary: Rerolls one of several specified dice rolls or tests.

warhammer-40k.power.command-re-roll.cost_or_limit: Costs 1 CP; the same Stratagem cannot be used twice in one phase.
warhammer-40k.power.command-re-roll.combines: Applies to the listed combat and psychic rolls or tests.
warhammer-40k.power.command-re-roll.blocked_reason: The effect can be represented as altering a roll result.

warhammer-40k.power.cut-them-down.name: CUT THEM DOWN

effect.summary: On specified dice results, inflicts mortal wounds on an enemy unit falling back.

warhammer-40k.power.cut-them-down.cost_or_limit: Costs 1 CP; requires enemy models to fall back while within engagement range.
warhammer-40k.power.cut-them-down.combines: Uses a die roll for each of the player's nearby models.
warhammer-40k.power.cut-them-down.blocked_reason: The wound effect can be represented as removing vitality.

warhammer-40k.power.desperate-breakout.name: DESPERATE BREAKOUT

effect.summary: Lets an engaged unit attempt to fall back across enemy models, with possible casualties.

warhammer-40k.power.desperate-breakout.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 CP; eligible unit must not have moved that phase.
warhammer-40k.power.desperate-breakout.go_wrong: Models can be destroyed on rolls of 1 or if they finish in engagement range.
warhammer-40k.power.desperate-breakout.combines: A surviving unit cannot act further that turn.
warhammer-40k.power.desperate-breakout.blocked_reason: The movement and casualty outcomes can be represented with the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.power.emergency-disembarka.name: EMERGENCY DISEMBARKATION

effect.summary: Allows embarked units to disembark within 6 inches of a destroyed transport instead of the usual 3.

warhammer-40k.power.emergency-disembarka.cost_or_limit: Costs 1 CP; used when a transport is destroyed.
warhammer-40k.power.emergency-disembarka.go_wrong: Each disembarked model has a chance of being destroyed on a roll of 1 or 2.
warhammer-40k.power.emergency-disembarka.who_may: A player with sufficient CP and units embarked in a destroyed transport.
warhammer-40k.power.emergency-disembarka.combines: The disembarking units avoid the transport's Explodes effect; they cannot charge or make a Heroic Intervention that turn.
warhammer-40k.power.emergency-disembarka.blocked_reason: The relocation and possible casualties can be represented with the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.power.fire-overwatch.name: FIRE OVERWATCH

effect.summary: Lets one targeted unit fire Overwatch before an enemy charge roll.

warhammer-40k.power.fire-overwatch.cost_or_limit: Costs 1 CP; used after an enemy declares a charge against one or more of the player's units.
warhammer-40k.power.fire-overwatch.who_may: A player with sufficient CP whose unit was targeted by the charge.
warhammer-40k.power.fire-overwatch.combines: Must be used before the charge roll.
warhammer-40k.power.fire-overwatch.blocked_reason: The attack can be represented as adding force.

warhammer-40k.power.counter-offensive.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE

effect.summary: Lets an eligible friendly unit fight immediately after an enemy unit has fought.

warhammer-40k.power.counter-offensive.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 CP; used after an enemy unit fights.
warhammer-40k.power.counter-offensive.who_may: A player with sufficient CP and an eligible unit.
warhammer-40k.power.counter-offensive.combines: Changes which eligible unit fights next.
warhammer-40k.power.counter-offensive.blocked_reason: The effect is a sequencing change that can be represented as an alteration.

warhammer-40k.power.insane-bravery.name: INSANE BRAVERY

effect.summary: Automatically passes a Morale test for one friendly unit.

warhammer-40k.power.insane-bravery.cost_or_limit: Costs 2 CP; usable only once per battle and before the test.
warhammer-40k.power.insane-bravery.who_may: A player with sufficient CP and a unit about to take a Morale test.
warhammer-40k.power.insane-bravery.combines: Replaces the test's normal roll and result.
warhammer-40k.power.insane-bravery.blocked_reason: The effect can be represented as altering the test outcome.

warhammer-40k.power.combat-squads.name: Combat Squads

effect.summary: The unit may split into combat squads while retaining one Crusade card and its Battle Honours.

warhammer-40k.power.combat-squads.cost_or_limit: Only one Crusade card is used; take an Out of Action test only if both squads are destroyed.
warhammer-40k.power.combat-squads.who_may: Units with the Combat Squads ability
warhammer-40k.power.combat-squads.combines: Overrides the Split Units rule for Crusade records.
warhammer-40k.power.combat-squads.blocked_reason: The described unit split and record handling can be represented directly.

warhammer-40k.power.assassins.name: Assassins

effect.summary: A unit earns two experience points for each enemy Character unit it destroys.

warhammer-40k.power.assassins.cost_or_limit: Record one tally mark per qualifying enemy Character destroyed.
warhammer-40k.power.assassins.blocked_reason: The condition and award are straightforward tally bookkeeping.

warhammer-40k.power.priority-target.name: Priority Target

effect.summary: A unit earns two experience points for each Vehicle or Monster unit it destroys.

warhammer-40k.power.priority-target.cost_or_limit: Record one tally mark per qualifying unit destroyed.
warhammer-40k.power.priority-target.blocked_reason: The condition and award are straightforward tally bookkeeping.

warhammer-40k.power.titan-hunter.name: Titan Hunter

effect.summary: A unit earns four experience points for each Titanic unit it destroys.

warhammer-40k.power.titan-hunter.cost_or_limit: Record one tally mark per qualifying unit destroyed.
warhammer-40k.power.titan-hunter.blocked_reason: The condition and award are straightforward tally bookkeeping.

warhammer-40k.power.king-slayer.name: King Slayer

effect.summary: The unit that finally destroys the enemy Warlord earns three experience points.

warhammer-40k.power.king-slayer.cost_or_limit: A later resurrection cancels the award for an earlier destruction; if destroyed again, the last destroyer qualifies.
warhammer-40k.power.king-slayer.go_wrong: Resurrection can invalidate the qualifying destruction.
warhammer-40k.power.king-slayer.who_may: A unit that destroys the enemy Warlord
warhammer-40k.power.king-slayer.combines: Depends on whether the Warlord is subsequently resurrected and destroyed again.
warhammer-40k.power.king-slayer.blocked_reason: Determining whether resurrection restores a destroyed character requires representing a death and return state.

warhammer-40k.power.first-strike.name: First Strike

effect.summary: A unit earns one experience point per enemy unit it destroys in the first battle round.

warhammer-40k.power.first-strike.blocked_reason: The round condition and tally are directly trackable.

warhammer-40k.power.cull-the-hordes.name: Cull the Hordes

effect.summary: A unit earns one experience point each time it destroys at least six models in a phase.

warhammer-40k.power.cull-the-hordes.blocked_reason: The condition and award use ordinary tally tracking.

warhammer-40k.power.reaper.name: Reaper

effect.summary: The unit with the highest enemy-unit destruction tally from the battle earns two experience points.

warhammer-40k.power.reaper.cost_or_limit: The player chooses among tied units.
warhammer-40k.power.reaper.who_may: A unit in the player’s army
warhammer-40k.power.reaper.blocked_reason: Comparison of recorded tallies is ordinary game bookkeeping.

warhammer-40k.power.sentinel.name: Sentinel

effect.summary: A chosen unit earns four experience points if it ends the battle near the selected marker that the player controls.

warhammer-40k.power.sentinel.cost_or_limit: Choose the marker and unit in the first Command phase.
warhammer-40k.power.sentinel.go_wrong: No experience is awarded unless both end conditions are met.
warhammer-40k.power.sentinel.who_may: One selected unit in the player’s army
warhammer-40k.power.sentinel.blocked_reason: The positional conditions and award can be resolved directly.

warhammer-40k.power.breakthrough.name: Breakthrough

effect.summary: Up to three eligible units earn two experience points each for ending near the opponent’s battlefield edge.

warhammer-40k.power.breakthrough.cost_or_limit: Units must be wholly within six inches; Aircraft are excluded.
warhammer-40k.power.breakthrough.who_may: Units in the player’s army, except Aircraft
warhammer-40k.power.breakthrough.blocked_reason: The position check and award are directly resolvable.

warhammer-40k.power.survivor.name: Survivor

effect.summary: A chosen unit earns two experience points if it survives, plus two more if it is not below half strength.

warhammer-40k.power.survivor.cost_or_limit: Single-model units use remaining wounds to determine the half-strength condition.
warhammer-40k.power.survivor.go_wrong: Destruction or falling below half strength prevents the corresponding award.
warhammer-40k.power.survivor.who_may: One selected unit in the player’s army
warhammer-40k.power.survivor.combines: Uses survival and strength at battle end.
warhammer-40k.power.survivor.blocked_reason: The survival and strength checks are ordinary game conditions.

warhammer-40k.power.secure-the-area.name: Secure the Area

effect.summary: A unit earns one experience point per successful action completed near the battlefield centre.

warhammer-40k.power.secure-the-area.cost_or_limit: One non-Character Infantry unit starts it at Movement-phase end within six inches of the centre; it completes at turn end.
warhammer-40k.power.secure-the-area.go_wrong: The tally is not gained if the action fails to complete.
warhammer-40k.power.secure-the-area.blocked_reason: The action and its tally can be resolved with normal turn timing.

warhammer-40k.power.search-for-archeotec.name: Search for Archeotech

effect.summary: A unit earns three experience points if it completes the search action twice.

warhammer-40k.power.search-for-archeotec.cost_or_limit: One or more Infantry units start in the opponent’s deployment zone at Movement-phase end; the action completes at turn end.
warhammer-40k.power.search-for-archeotec.go_wrong: No award unless the tally reaches two.
warhammer-40k.power.search-for-archeotec.who_may: Infantry units in the player’s army
warhammer-40k.power.search-for-archeotec.blocked_reason: The action, tally, and threshold are ordinary game bookkeeping.

warhammer-40k.power.deploy-vox-relay.name: Deploy Vox-relay

effect.summary: A unit completes an action to place a Vox-relay on an objective marker, earning experience for relays still deployed at battle end.

warhammer-40k.power.deploy-vox-relay.cost_or_limit: Select an Infantry unit before the first turn; a relay is lost if the opponent controls its marker at a phase start.
warhammer-40k.power.deploy-vox-relay.go_wrong: Opponent control can cause a deployed relay to be lost.
warhammer-40k.power.deploy-vox-relay.combines: The action requires an objective without an existing friendly relay.
warhammer-40k.power.deploy-vox-relay.mechanism: objective marker state and experience award
warhammer-40k.power.deploy-vox-relay.blocked_reason: The relay and its loss are represented as marker state.

warhammer-40k.power.recover-mission-arch.name: Recover Mission Archives

effect.summary: After a qualifying search, one participating unit may earn six experience points based on a roll and the combined search tallies.

warhammer-40k.power.recover-mission-arch.cost_or_limit: Infantry, Cavalry, or Biker starts within marker range; it must remain there until the next Command phase. The roll must not exceed the combined tally, unless that tally equals the number of markers.
warhammer-40k.power.recover-mission-arch.go_wrong: The award fails if the roll and tally condition is not met.
warhammer-40k.power.recover-mission-arch.combines: Uses all units’ combined tallies and a D6 roll.
warhammer-40k.power.recover-mission-arch.mechanism: delayed action, tally check, and award
warhammer-40k.power.recover-mission-arch.blocked_reason: The action timing and numeric test can be resolved with ordinary game rules.

warhammer-40k.power.witch-hunter.name: Witch Hunter

effect.summary: A unit earns experience for destroying enemy Psykers, with extra tally credit for a Psyker Character.

warhammer-40k.power.witch-hunter.cost_or_limit: Add one tally per Psyker, or three for a Psyker Character.
warhammer-40k.power.witch-hunter.combines: Psyker Characters count for three tally marks.
warhammer-40k.power.witch-hunter.blocked_reason: The tally and award are directly trackable.

warhammer-40k.power.lord-of-the-warp.name: Lord of the Warp

effect.summary: The unit with the highest tally of psychic successes earns two experience points.

warhammer-40k.power.lord-of-the-warp.cost_or_limit: Gain tally for manifesting, denying, or completing a psychic action; a unit’s tally resets to zero when it suffers Perils of the Warp.
warhammer-40k.power.lord-of-the-warp.go_wrong: Perils of the Warp erase that unit’s tally.
warhammer-40k.power.lord-of-the-warp.combines: Only the highest nonzero tally qualifies; the player chooses among ties.
warhammer-40k.power.lord-of-the-warp.blocked_reason: It requires tracking game events and a tally, not an unsupported effect.

warhammer-40k.power.tenacious.name: TENACIOUS

warhammer-40k.power.touched-by-fate.name: Touched By Fate

warhammer-40k.power.uncanny-trait.name: Uncanny [Trait]

warhammer-40k.power.unnatural-skill.name: Unnatural [Skill]

warhammer-40k.power.warped-mind.name: Warped Mind

effect.summary: Allows learning psychic powers from one additional psychic discipline.

warhammer-40k.power.warped-mind.cost_or_limit: Costs 30 XP; requires Psychic Mastery Rating 4+; may take Corruption to reduce XP cost by 5 per point.
warhammer-40k.power.warped-mind.go_wrong: Taking Corruption is the stated cost-reduction option.
warhammer-40k.power.warped-mind.mind: The character has opened their mind to another discipline.

warhammer-40k.power.warped-mind.blocked_reason: The added discipline access can be represented as a character capability.

warhammer-40k.power.trademark-weapon.name: Trademark Weapon

effect.summary: Adds double Rank ED on successful attacks with one chosen weapon.

warhammer-40k.power.trademark-weapon.where_from: Extensive training with a single weapon.
warhammer-40k.power.trademark-weapon.combines: Applies only to the selected weapon, not all weapons of its type.
warhammer-40k.power.trademark-weapon.blocked_reason: The Talent’s benefit is attached to a particular item and depends on that item remaining in the user’s possession.

warhammer-40k.power.transhuman-attribute.name: Transhuman [Attribute]

effect.summary: Adds double Rank bonus dice to tests using one chosen Attribute.

warhammer-40k.power.transhuman-attribute.cost_or_limit: Costs 60 XP; requires the chosen Attribute to have Rating 5+.
warhammer-40k.power.transhuman-attribute.who_may: Characters with Rating 5+ in the chosen Attribute.
warhammer-40k.power.transhuman-attribute.blocked_reason: The test bonus can be represented with a basic effect.

warhammer-40k.power.twin-focus.name: Twin Focus

effect.summary: Reduces by 2 the DN penalty for sustaining multiple psychic powers.

warhammer-40k.power.twin-focus.cost_or_limit: Costs 20 XP; requires Psychic Mastery Rating 4+.
warhammer-40k.power.twin-focus.mind: Enables the character to split their thoughts between two Warp manipulations.
warhammer-40k.power.twin-focus.combines: Interacts with sustaining multiple psychic powers.
warhammer-40k.power.twin-focus.blocked_reason: Changing the penalty for sustaining several powers requires an explicit interaction between powers.

warhammer-40k.power.bolstering-purity.name: Bolstering Purity

effect.summary: Spending Faith lets one nearby Imperial Cult character automatically succeed at Resolve and Conviction tests for the round.

warhammer-40k.power.bolstering-purity.cost_or_limit: Costs 40 XP; requires an obscured Keyword; grants 1 Faith; reflexive action; requires hearing range; cannot be used again until a Regroup.
warhammer-40k.power.bolstering-purity.go_wrong: Unavailable again until the user completes a Regroup.
warhammer-40k.power.bolstering-purity.who_may: Characters meeting the Talent’s Keyword requirement.
warhammer-40k.power.bolstering-purity.where_from: Words imbued with the Emperor’s will.
warhammer-40k.power.bolstering-purity.combines: Can target the user; affects a character with the specified Imperial Keyword.
warhammer-40k.power.bolstering-purity.blocked_reason: A temporary test benefit on one selected character can be represented with a basic effect.

warhammer-40k.power.by-his-will.name: By His Will

effect.summary: Spending Faith while helping a character with the specified Keyword triples the bonus dice provided.

warhammer-40k.power.by-his-will.cost_or_limit: Costs 20 XP; requires one of two obscured Keyword options; grants 1 Faith; requires spending 1 Faith when helping.
warhammer-40k.power.by-his-will.mind: The character’s faith lets them call on the Emperor’s aid.
warhammer-40k.power.by-his-will.who_may: Characters meeting the Talent’s Keyword requirement.
warhammer-40k.power.by-his-will.combines: Applies when helping a character with the specified Keyword.
warhammer-40k.power.by-his-will.blocked_reason: The bonus to a helping action can be represented with a basic effect.

warhammer-40k.power.consecrated-light.name: Consecrated Light

effect.summary: Spending Faith and presenting a holy symbol improves Fear and Corruption tests for the user and nearby allies with the specified Keyword for a round.

warhammer-40k.power.consecrated-light.cost_or_limit: Costs 20 XP; requires a Keyword; grants 1 Faith; reflexive action; range is 15 + double Rank metres.
warhammer-40k.power.consecrated-light.mind: Bolsters the faithful through a physical manifestation of the Emperor’s power.
warhammer-40k.power.consecrated-light.who_may: Characters meeting the Talent’s Keyword requirement; benefits specified allies nearby.
warhammer-40k.power.consecrated-light.where_from: The Emperor’s power manifesting for the faithful.
warhammer-40k.power.consecrated-light.combines: Requires presenting a holy symbol; affects allies with the specified Keyword.
warhammer-40k.power.consecrated-light.blocked_reason: The effect applies to multiple allies in a radius.

warhammer-40k.power.divine-guidance.name: Divine Guidance

effect.summary: Spending Faith improves one character’s Ballistic Skill tests for a round.

warhammer-40k.power.divine-guidance.cost_or_limit: Costs 20 XP; requires one of two obscured Keyword options; grants 1 Faith; combat action; target must be within hearing range.
warhammer-40k.power.divine-guidance.who_may: Characters meeting the Talent’s Keyword requirement; target has the specified Keyword.
warhammer-40k.power.divine-guidance.blocked_reason: A one-round test bonus on one target can be represented with a basic effect.

warhammer-40k.power.in-his-name.name: In His Name

effect.summary: Spending Faith improves a Persuasion or Leadership test against a character with the specified Keyword.

warhammer-40k.power.in-his-name.cost_or_limit: Costs 20 XP; requires an obscured Keyword option and Scholar Rating 1+; grants 1 Faith.
warhammer-40k.power.in-his-name.where_from: Study of the Cult Imperialis writings.
warhammer-40k.power.in-his-name.combines: Applies when targeting a character with the specified Keyword using Persuasion or Leadership.
warhammer-40k.power.in-his-name.blocked_reason: A conditional test bonus can be represented with a basic effect.

warhammer-40k.power.inspired-blessing.name: Inspired Blessing

effect.summary: Spending Faith restores Shock to the user and nearby allies with the specified Keyword.

warhammer-40k.power.inspired-blessing.cost_or_limit: Costs 25 XP; requires a Keyword; grants 1 Faith; combat action; restores 1d3 + double Rank Shock; range is 15 + double Rank metres.
warhammer-40k.power.inspired-blessing.mind: The blessing uplifts allies and reinforces determination.
warhammer-40k.power.inspired-blessing.who_may: Characters meeting the Talent’s Keyword requirement and nearby allies with that Keyword.
warhammer-40k.power.inspired-blessing.where_from: The character’s blessings invoke the God-Emperor.
warhammer-40k.power.inspired-blessing.combines: Triggered by an inspirational statement or prayer.
warhammer-40k.power.inspired-blessing.blocked_reason: The effect restores Shock to multiple targets in a radius.

warhammer-40k.power.litany-of-hatred.name: Litany Of Hatred

effect.summary: Spending Faith extends the user’s Hatred Talent’s effects to nearby allies with the specified Keyword.

warhammer-40k.power.litany-of-hatred.cost_or_limit: Costs 20 XP; requires an obscured Keyword option and the Hatred Talent; grants 1 Faith; simple action; range is Rank × 10 metres.
warhammer-40k.power.litany-of-hatred.who_may: Characters meeting the stated requirements; nearby allies must have the specified Keyword.
warhammer-40k.power.litany-of-hatred.where_from: Imperial hatred described as a gift to humanity.
warhammer-40k.power.litany-of-hatred.combines: Extends the effects of the Hatred Talent.
warhammer-40k.power.litany-of-hatred.blocked_reason: The Talent transfers or extends another power’s effect to allies.

warhammer-40k.power.martyr-s-tears.name: Martyr’s Tears

effect.summary: The user sacrifices Wounds to restore twice that number to a human target.

warhammer-40k.power.martyr-s-tears.cost_or_limit: Costs 20 XP; requires an obscured Keyword option and Willpower Rating 3+; grants 1 Faith; simple action; sacrifice up to Tier Wounds and spend 1 Faith.
warhammer-40k.power.martyr-s-tears.go_wrong: The user loses the sacrificed Wounds.
warhammer-40k.power.martyr-s-tears.mind: The character is prepared to sacrifice themselves in service to the Emperor.
warhammer-40k.power.martyr-s-tears.who_may: Characters meeting the stated requirements; target must be human.
warhammer-40k.power.martyr-s-tears.where_from: A destiny of martyrdom and service to the Emperor.
warhammer-40k.power.martyr-s-tears.combines: The target recovers twice the number of Wounds sacrificed.
warhammer-40k.power.martyr-s-tears.blocked_reason: A transfer of Wounds between two targets can be represented with basic effects.

warhammer-40k.power.repent.name: Repent!

effect.summary: A successful opposed Intimidation test makes a qualifying Imperial Cult target kneel and repent for a duration based on Rank.

warhammer-40k.power.repent.cost_or_limit: Costs 20 XP; requires an obscured Keyword and Willpower Rating 3+; grants 1 Faith; spend 1 Faith; in combat uses a combat action; opposed test with Rank bonus dice.
warhammer-40k.power.repent.go_wrong: The attempt fails if the opposed test is lost or the target lacks the required Keyword.
warhammer-40k.power.repent.who_may: Characters meeting the Talent’s requirements; target must have the specified Keyword.
warhammer-40k.power.repent.where_from: The user’s righteous indignation and force of will.
warhammer-40k.power.repent.combines: Works against another adherent of the Imperial Cult.
warhammer-40k.power.repent.blocked_reason: Forcing a target to kneel and repent is a direct compulsion of another character’s mind and behaviour.

warhammer-40k.power.righteous-wrath.name: Righteous Wrath

effect.summary: Spending Faith grants the user Wrath, which can be shared with a nearby faithful ally.

warhammer-40k.power.righteous-wrath.cost_or_limit: Costs 20 XP; requires an obscured Keyword and Willpower Rating 3+; grants 1 Faith; combat action; gain 2 Wrath and may sacrifice 1 to grant an ally 1 Wrath.
warhammer-40k.power.righteous-wrath.go_wrong: Sharing requires sacrificing 1 of the Wrath just gained.
warhammer-40k.power.righteous-wrath.mind: Burning fervour inspires deeds and allies.
warhammer-40k.power.righteous-wrath.who_may: Characters meeting the requirements; the ally must have the specified Keyword, hear the user, and be faithful to the Imperial Cult.
warhammer-40k.power.righteous-wrath.combines: Can transfer a point of Wrath to an ally.
warhammer-40k.power.righteous-wrath.blocked_reason: The effect transfers a resource point from the user to another character.

warhammer-40k.power.shield-of-faith.name: Shield Of Faith

effect.summary: Spending Faith lets the user ignore a psychic power or effect, including Perils of the Warp, for a round; extra Faith extends this protection to nearby allies.

warhammer-40k.power.shield-of-faith.cost_or_limit: Costs 20 XP; requires a Keyword and Willpower Rating 3+; grants 1 Faith; reflexive action; spend an additional Faith for allies within 15 + double Rank metres.
warhammer-40k.power.shield-of-faith.mind: Steels the user’s mind against Warp effects.
warhammer-40k.power.shield-of-faith.who_may: Characters meeting the Talent’s requirements; allies must have the specified Keyword.
warhammer-40k.power.shield-of-faith.combines: Can negate psychic powers, effects, and Perils of the Warp.

warhammer-40k.power.the-passion.name: The Passion

effect.summary: Spending Faith improves one character’s Weapon Skill tests for a round.

warhammer-40k.power.the-passion.cost_or_limit: Costs 20 XP; requires one of two obscured Keyword options; grants 1 Faith; combat action; target must be within hearing range.
warhammer-40k.power.the-passion.mind: The Emperor’s visage inspires destructive fervour.
warhammer-40k.power.the-passion.who_may: Characters meeting the Talent’s Keyword requirement; target has the specified Keyword.
warhammer-40k.power.the-passion.where_from: The user turns their thoughts to the Emperor’s glory.
warhammer-40k.power.the-passion.blocked_reason: A one-round test bonus on one target can be represented with a basic effect.

warhammer-40k.power.back-from-the-brink.name: Back From The Brink

effect.summary: Represents survival after an apparent death, with lost body parts replaced by augmetics and specified injuries incurred.

warhammer-40k.power.back-from-the-brink.cost_or_limit: Costs 10 × new Tier; choose the faction of the rescuers as a Keyword; roll twice on both Memorable Injury and Traumatic Injury tables; replacement augmetics have GM-set rarity.

warhammer-40k.power.back-from-the-brink.where_from: Reconstructed by rescuers using technology after a near-fatal event.
warhammer-40k.power.back-from-the-brink.combines: Rescuers may demand repayment; lost body parts are replaced with augmetics.
warhammer-40k.power.back-from-the-brink.blocked_reason: The package involves reconstruction, replacing lost body parts, and consequences of a changed body.

warhammer-40k.power.dauntless-reputation.name: Dauntless Reputation

effect.summary: Grants reputation, influence, devoted followers, and a nemesis after an impressive deed.

warhammer-40k.power.dauntless-reputation.combines: Grants Devotees, faction reputation, and a nemesis.
warhammer-40k.power.dauntless-reputation.blocked_reason: The package’s social benefits and narrative constraints can be represented as character relationships.

warhammer-40k.power.perfidious-wretch.name: Perfidious Wretch

effect.summary: Removes the betrayed faction Keyword, grants a new faction Keyword, and provides resources from the new allies.

warhammer-40k.power.perfidious-wretch.cost_or_limit: Costs 5 × new Tier; requires Cunning 3; removes the betrayed Keyword; reduces Influence by 2; grants 3 Wealth and one Rare-or-lower Wargear item of value 3 + new Tier.

warhammer-40k.power.perfidious-wretch.who_may: Characters meeting the stated requirement and selecting a faction to betray and join.
warhammer-40k.power.perfidious-wretch.where_from: Defection driven by power, wealth, or changed convictions.
warhammer-40k.power.perfidious-wretch.combines: Changes faction allegiance and grants Wargear and Wealth.

warhammer-40k.power.psychic-revelations.name: Psychic Revelations

effect.summary: Makes the character a Psyker, granting Smite, Universal Psychic Powers, additional Minor Psychic Powers, and access to one chosen Discipline.

warhammer-40k.power.multi-attack.name: Multi-Attack

effect.summary: Attack multiple targets with one weapon, using one damage roll for those hit.

warhammer-40k.power.shot-to-disarm.go_wrong: The target keeps its weapon if it passes the test.

warhammer-40k.power.shot-to-bypass-armou.name: Shot To Bypass Armour

warhammer-40k.power.shot-to-bypass-armou.blocked_reason: It alters the target’s armour protection for an attack.

warhammer-40k.power.full-defence.name: Full Defence

warhammer-40k.power.hold-action.name: Hold Action

warhammer-40k.power.hold-action.who_may: A character choosing to delay a Combat Action.

warhammer-40k.power.charge.name: Charge

warhammer-40k.power.charge.combines: Combines movement with a melee attack.
warhammer-40k.power.charge.blocked_reason: Movement and an attack bonus fit the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.power.fall-back.name: Fall Back

warhammer-40k.power.grapple.name: Grapple

warhammer-40k.power.aim.name: Aim

warhammer-40k.power.aim.who_may: A character using a ranged weapon.

warhammer-40k.power.brace.name: Brace

warhammer-40k.power.brace.blocked_reason: It removes a weapon penalty under stated conditions.

warhammer-40k.power.shoot-through-cover.name: Shoot Through Cover

warhammer-40k.power.inferno.name: INFERNO*

warhammer-40k.power.cauterise.name: CAUTERISE*

warhammer-40k.power.pyrelight.name: PYRELIGHT*

warhammer-40k.power.smouldercloud.name: SMOULDERCLOUD*

effect.summary: Reduces allies’ fire and heat damage and conceals them from thermal auspex.

warhammer-40k.power.breach.name: BREACH

warhammer-40k.power.beacon.name: BEACON

warhammer-40k.power.mental-interrogation.name: MENTAL INTERROGATION

warhammer-40k.rule.out-of-action-test.combines: A failed test offers a choice between the two consequences.
warhammer-40k.rule.out-of-action-test.blocked_reason: The chance test and its outcomes fit ordinary game resolution.

warhammer-40k.rule.marked-for-greatness.name: Marked for Greatness

effect.summary: One participating unit receives three experience points after the battle.

warhammer-40k.rule.marked-for-greatness.cost_or_limit: One unit per player is selected, unless a mission victor bonus changes this.
warhammer-40k.rule.marked-for-greatness.who_may: A unit in the player’s army list for the battle
warhammer-40k.rule.marked-for-greatness.combines: Mission victor bonuses may permit selecting additional units.
warhammer-40k.rule.marked-for-greatness.blocked_reason: This is a direct experience-point award.

warhammer-40k.rule.dealers-of-death.name: Dealers of Death

effect.summary: A unit gains one experience point for every three enemy units it has destroyed in total.

warhammer-40k.rule.dealers-of-death.cost_or_limit: Awarded at the stated post-battle update.
warhammer-40k.rule.dealers-of-death.combines: Uses the unit’s cumulative destruction tally.
warhammer-40k.rule.dealers-of-death.blocked_reason: The tally converts directly into experience points.

warhammer-40k.rule.the-relic.name: The Relic

effect.summary: An Infantry unit can carry the central relic after completing an action beside its marker.

warhammer-40k.rule.the-relic.cost_or_limit: The unit must remain within an inch and have no enemy non-Aircraft unit in Engagement Range; a carrier cannot embark or be removed and set up elsewhere.
warhammer-40k.rule.the-relic.go_wrong: If the carrying model is destroyed, the marker is placed near where it fell, even if it later returns.
warhammer-40k.rule.the-relic.who_may: One Infantry unit from an army
warhammer-40k.rule.the-relic.combines: Carrying the relic affects transport and removal abilities; possession and control score mission points.
warhammer-40k.rule.the-relic.blocked_reason: The relic is a mission marker whose carrying and dropping states are directly trackable.

warhammer-40k.rule.sabotage.name: Sabotage

effect.summary: The Attacker removes an objective marker after a unit completes the sabotage action beside it.

warhammer-40k.rule.sabotage.cost_or_limit: One attacking unit starts within an inch at Movement-phase end; completion is at the Attacker’s turn end.
warhammer-40k.rule.sabotage.who_may: One unit from the Attacker’s army
warhammer-40k.rule.sabotage.combines: Removing the marker awards the Attacker mission points and reduces the Defender’s remaining markers.
warhammer-40k.rule.sabotage.blocked_reason: The action and marker removal are direct game-state changes.

warhammer-40k.rule.recon-sweep.name: Recon Sweep

effect.summary: A unit completes an action to mark a table quarter as reconnoitred.

warhammer-40k.rule.recon-sweep.cost_or_limit: Start wholly in an unsearched quarter and more than ten inches from the battlefield centre; remain wholly there until turn end.
warhammer-40k.rule.recon-sweep.go_wrong: The action fails if the unit does not remain in the quarter.
warhammer-40k.rule.recon-sweep.blocked_reason: The quarter’s status and scoring can be tracked as ordinary game state.

warhammer-40k.rule.recon-patrol-reserve-.name: Recon Patrol reserve test

effect.summary: A reserve unit seeking to arrive in rounds one or two rolls a D6 and arrives on a four or higher.

warhammer-40k.rule.recon-patrol-reserve-.cost_or_limit: Each player places at least half their units in Strategic Reserves; no more than three quarters of units and less than three quarters of Power Level may be reserved or reinforcements.
warhammer-40k.rule.recon-patrol-reserve-.go_wrong: On a failed test the unit remains in reserve until round three.
warhammer-40k.rule.recon-patrol-reserve-.who_may: Reserve units seeking early arrival in Recon Patrol
warhammer-40k.rule.recon-patrol-reserve-.combines: The mission waives Command-point costs for Strategic Reserves.
warhammer-40k.rule.recon-patrol-reserve-.blocked_reason: The timing, roll, and arrival outcome are directly representable.

warhammer-40k.rule.the-warp-is-the-only-.name: The warp is the only route between distant stars

effect.summary: Interstellar travel between distant stars uses the warp as its only route.

warhammer-40k.rule.the-warp-is-the-only-.cost_or_limit: The route passes through the warp.
warhammer-40k.rule.the-warp-is-the-only-.go_wrong: The warp is infested with daemons.
warhammer-40k.rule.the-warp-is-the-only-.where_from: The setting’s account of space travel
warhammer-40k.rule.the-warp-is-the-only-.combines: The Astronomican guides fleets through it.
warhammer-40k.rule.the-warp-is-the-only-.blocked_reason: This is a world rule describing the required route for interstellar travel.

warhammer-40k.rule.warp-travel-and-time.name: Warp travel and time

effect.summary: Travel through the warp can cover vast distances quickly, but time passes unpredictably relative to realspace.

warhammer-40k.rule.warp-travel-and-time.cost_or_limit: Elapsed time can differ by months or years.
warhammer-40k.rule.warp-travel-and-time.go_wrong: Ships may arrive late, be displaced, or become trapped in stasis.
warhammer-40k.rule.warp-travel-and-time.combines: Powered by ancient engines that push ships into the immaterium.
warhammer-40k.rule.warp-travel-and-time.blocked_reason: The passage describes time distortion and possible indefinite stasis, beyond the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.legacy-of-wealth.name: Legacy of Wealth

effect.summary: A noble character increases the group’s starting Profit Factor by 1.

warhammer-40k.rule.legacy-of-wealth.cost_or_limit: Applies to the group’s starting resource.
warhammer-40k.rule.legacy-of-wealth.blocked_reason: This rule can be represented as a change to a numerical starting resource.

warhammer-40k.rule.origin-path-effects.name: Origin Path effects

effect.summary: Origin options grant the listed benefits and drawbacks when chosen.

warhammer-40k.rule.origin-path-effects.cost_or_limit: Select among the options described for the relevant trait.
warhammer-40k.rule.origin-path-effects.go_wrong: Some choices impose penalties, Insanity Points, or resource loss.
warhammer-40k.rule.origin-path-effects.mind: Some choices inflict Insanity Points or behavioral compulsions.
warhammer-40k.rule.origin-path-effects.combines: Choices can affect talents, skills, characteristics, and group resources.

warhammer-40k.rule.fate-point-recovery-r.name: Fate Point recovery reroll

effect.summary: Against All Odds allows a reroll when spending a Fate Point to recover Wounds, but the second result must stand.

warhammer-40k.rule.fate-point-recovery-r.cost_or_limit: Must accept the second dice result even if worse.
warhammer-40k.rule.fate-point-recovery-r.go_wrong: The reroll may yield a poorer recovery result.
warhammer-40k.rule.fate-point-recovery-r.combines: Applies when spending Fate Points to recover Wounds.

warhammer-40k.rule.starting-experience.name: Starting Experience

effect.summary: Characters start with 4,500 xp already represented by their existing abilities and receive 500 xp to spend.

warhammer-40k.rule.starting-experience.cost_or_limit: Starting total after spending is 5,000 xp.
warhammer-40k.rule.starting-experience.combines: Experience spent determines Career Path Rank.

warhammer-40k.rule.heirloom-item-selecti.name: Heirloom Item selection

effect.summary: A Pride character may choose an item or Toughness; the table assigns an heirloom by d100 result.

warhammer-40k.rule.heirloom-item-selecti.cost_or_limit: The table has five result bands, each awarding one item.
warhammer-40k.rule.heirloom-item-selecti.who_may: Characters choosing the Heirloom Item option.
warhammer-40k.rule.heirloom-item-selecti.combines: Items may carry conditional bonuses or equipment qualities.

warhammer-40k.rule.characteristic-advanc.name: Characteristic Advance progression

effect.summary: A characteristic rises by five per advance and must be bought through Simple, Intermediate, Trained, then Expert.

warhammer-40k.rule.characteristic-advanc.cost_or_limit: Costs are cumulative by progression level.
warhammer-40k.rule.characteristic-advanc.go_wrong: A player cannot skip the earlier levels.

warhammer-40k.rule.starting-profit-facto.name: Starting Profit Factor and Ship Points

effect.summary: A d10 roll determines the group’s starting Profit Factor and Ship Points using the table.

warhammer-40k.rule.starting-profit-facto.cost_or_limit: The result maps to paired values in Table 1–5.
warhammer-40k.rule.starting-profit-facto.who_may: The group or Game Master making the roll.
warhammer-40k.rule.starting-profit-facto.combines: Origin choices may adjust starting Profit Factor.

warhammer-40k.rule.unspent-ship-points-c.name: Unspent Ship Points conversion

effect.summary: Unspent Ship Points convert to group Profit Factor at one to one.

warhammer-40k.rule.unspent-ship-points-c.cost_or_limit: Only Ship Points left unspent are converted.

warhammer-40k.rule.starting-equipment-ac.name: Starting equipment acquisition

effect.summary: Each character may make one acquisition of a single Armoury item at modifier +0 using group Profit Factor.

warhammer-40k.rule.starting-equipment-ac.cost_or_limit: One item per character under the standard option.
warhammer-40k.rule.starting-equipment-ac.go_wrong: An optional common-equipment approach may take substantial time.
warhammer-40k.rule.starting-equipment-ac.combines: Uses group Profit Factor and the Armoury.

warhammer-40k.rule.dark-heresy-character.name: Dark Heresy character conversion

effect.summary: A Dark Heresy character with 5,000 xp is treated as roughly equivalent to a Rank 1 Rogue Trader character at 5,000 xp.

warhammer-40k.rule.dark-heresy-character.cost_or_limit: Characters joining as crew gain the benefits of Profit Factor; passengers normally retain monthly income and gain Profit Factor only at GM discretion.
warhammer-40k.rule.dark-heresy-character.go_wrong: The GM may adjust a Rogue Trader character’s income when serving an Inquisitor.
warhammer-40k.rule.dark-heresy-character.who_may: Dark Heresy characters entering Rogue Trader games and vice versa.
warhammer-40k.rule.dark-heresy-character.combines: Uses the games’ shared core mechanics.
warhammer-40k.rule.dark-heresy-character.mechanism: Character conversion and campaign resource eligibility.

effect.summary: A character’s Rank rises after an Advance is taken once total spent experience reaches the required threshold.

warhammer-40k.rule.ranks-are-chosen-when.name: Ranks are chosen when multiple qualify

effect.summary: When eligible for multiple Ranks, a character must choose one; higher Ranks may require prerequisites.

warhammer-40k.rule.ranks-are-chosen-when.combines: Prior Ranks, Skills, or Characteristics may be prerequisites.

warhammer-40k.rule.repeated-advances-are.name: Repeated Advances are capped

effect.summary: An Advance marked with a multiplier may be bought repeatedly at its Rank, up to the indicated number.

warhammer-40k.rule.repeated-advances-are.cost_or_limit: The multiplier sets the purchase maximum.
warhammer-40k.rule.repeated-advances-are.combines: Applies to Advances carrying an x-number marker.

warhammer-40k.rule.warp-exposure-can-cor.name: Warp exposure can corrupt and destroy souls

effect.summary: Warp exposure and corrupted engramatic code can corrupt an Explorator and cost them their soul.

warhammer-40k.rule.warp-exposure-can-cor.cost_or_limit: Exposure to warp-tainted technologies carries severe danger.
warhammer-40k.rule.warp-exposure-can-cor.combines: May follow encounters with alien technologies or doctrine.
warhammer-40k.rule.warp-exposure-can-cor.blocked_reason: Soul loss and corruption are persistent soul-state changes beyond the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-requirement.name: Navigator requirement for long warp voyages

effect.summary: Without a Navigator, a ship can make only short jumps; longer travel is extremely risky without detailed ancient charts and precise cogitator calibration.

warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-requirement.cost_or_limit: Unaided travel is limited to a few light-years per jump
warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-requirement.go_wrong: Small navigation errors can kill the vessel and everyone aboard
warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-requirement.combines: A Navigator uses the Astronomican to guide travel
warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-requirement.blocked_reason: This is a setting constraint rather than an unimplemented power effect.

warhammer-40k.rule.warp-perception-endan.name: Warp perception endangers mind and soul

effect.summary: No one can behold the warp in its true form without risking destruction of mind and soul; even Navigators perceive it subjectively or through a filtering third eye.

warhammer-40k.rule.warp-perception-endan.go_wrong: Mind and soul may be destroyed; long service may also cause madness, bodily failure, or mutation
warhammer-40k.rule.warp-perception-endan.who_may: Anyone exposed to the warp, including Navigators
warhammer-40k.rule.warp-perception-endan.combines: Experience and the Navigator's third eye can filter perception
warhammer-40k.rule.warp-perception-endan.blocked_reason: The rule explicitly involves damage to or destruction of a soul, which the basic effect grammar cannot model.

warhammer-40k.rule.basic-and-advanced-sk.name: Basic and Advanced Skills

effect.summary: Basic skills can be attempted untrained at half the governing characteristic; advanced skills require training.

warhammer-40k.rule.basic-and-advanced-sk.cost_or_limit: Untrained basic-skill tests use half the characteristic, rounded down
warhammer-40k.rule.basic-and-advanced-sk.go_wrong: Untrained advanced skills cannot be used
warhammer-40k.rule.basic-and-advanced-sk.combines: Advanced skills may sometimes be treated as basic by a trait
warhammer-40k.rule.basic-and-advanced-sk.blocked_reason: This is a game procedure rule, not a world mechanism.

warhammer-40k.rule.skill-mastery.name: Skill Mastery

effect.summary: Acquiring a skill repeatedly grants +10, then +20, with a maximum of three acquisitions.

warhammer-40k.rule.skill-mastery.cost_or_limit: Same skill can be acquired at most three times
warhammer-40k.rule.skill-mastery.combines: Second acquisition grants +10; third raises it to +20
warhammer-40k.rule.skill-mastery.blocked_reason: This is a game procedure rule, not a world mechanism.

warhammer-40k.rule.crafting-skills.name: Crafting Skills

effect.summary: Crafting requires materials, tools, workspace, time, and skill; failure can ruin materials.

warhammer-40k.rule.crafting-skills.cost_or_limit: Three degrees of failure ruin some materials; five ruin all
warhammer-40k.rule.crafting-skills.mechanism: Extended skill test and material loss
warhammer-40k.rule.crafting-skills.blocked_reason: This is a game procedure rule rather than a world mechanism.

warhammer-40k.rule.explosives-placement-.name: Explosives placement and failure

effect.summary: Successful placement arms a charge; failure makes it fail to detonate, while severe failure may detonate it on its installer.

warhammer-40k.rule.explosives-placement-.cost_or_limit: Four or more degrees of failure cause self-detonation
warhammer-40k.rule.explosives-placement-.go_wrong: A poorly placed or defused charge may detonate
warhammer-40k.rule.explosives-placement-.combines: Charges may use trip wires, timers, proximity sensors, or remote activators
warhammer-40k.rule.explosives-placement-.blocked_reason: The passage gives a clear trigger and failure mechanism.

effect.summary: Wrangling has no effect on cyber-animals, psy-bonded animals, or truly sentient creatures.

warhammer-40k.rule.languages-enable-comm.name: Languages enable communication without tests

effect.summary: Speakers who share a language generally need no test unless conditions are adverse or concepts complex.

warhammer-40k.rule.languages-enable-comm.cost_or_limit: Tests may be needed for poor links, obscure dialects, or complex ideas.

warhammer-40k.rule.maximal-plasma-firing.name: Maximal plasma firing mode

effect.summary: Plasma weapons can trade three rounds of ammunition for extra range, damage, and penetration; the mode also adds recharge, and increases blast size on weapons with Blast.

warhammer-40k.rule.maximal-plasma-firing.cost_or_limit: Uses three rounds and gains Recharge.
warhammer-40k.rule.maximal-plasma-firing.combines: Interacts with Recharge and Blast qualities.
warhammer-40k.rule.maximal-plasma-firing.blocked_reason: The rule can be represented as resource cost and a delayed reuse limit.

warhammer-40k.rule.grenade-throwing-and-.name: Grenade throwing and scatter

effect.summary: Throwing a grenade requires no special training; a miss sends it in a random direction.

warhammer-40k.rule.grenade-throwing-and-.cost_or_limit: A Ballistic Skill test with applicable modifiers resolves the throw.
warhammer-40k.rule.grenade-throwing-and-.who_may: Anyone able to throw a grenade.
warhammer-40k.rule.grenade-throwing-and-.combines: A scatter diagram determines the direction.
warhammer-40k.rule.grenade-throwing-and-.blocked_reason: The rule is a straightforward attack and random-direction procedure.

warhammer-40k.rule.when-a-grenade-jams.name: When a Grenade “Jams”

effect.summary: A jam normally makes the explosive a dud, but a rare roll causes it to detonate on the attacker; launcher detonation also destroys the weapon.

warhammer-40k.rule.when-a-grenade-jams.go_wrong: Immediate explosion at the attacker; a launcher blast destroys the launcher.
warhammer-40k.rule.when-a-grenade-jams.who_may: Applies to thrown grenades and grenade launchers or similar weapons.
warhammer-40k.rule.when-a-grenade-jams.combines: The explosive uses its normal effect when it detonates.
warhammer-40k.rule.when-a-grenade-jams.blocked_reason: The mishap is representable as a random trigger and an effect.

warhammer-40k.rule.shock-weapon-training.name: Shock weapon training

effect.summary: Using shock weapons requires the Melee Weapon Training (Shock) talent.

warhammer-40k.rule.shock-weapon-training.cost_or_limit: Shock weapon use requires a specific talent.
warhammer-40k.rule.shock-weapon-training.blocked_reason: A character qualification can be checked as a rule.

warhammer-40k.rule.unusual-ammunition-ex.name: Unusual ammunition exclusivity

effect.summary: A weapon uses only one unusual ammunition type at a time; their effects cannot be combined.

warhammer-40k.rule.unusual-ammunition-ex.cost_or_limit: Only one unusual ammunition type can be active at a time.
warhammer-40k.rule.unusual-ammunition-ex.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward restriction on ammunition choice.

warhammer-40k.rule.armour-values-do-not-.name: Armour values do not stack

effect.summary: When multiple armour pieces cover one location, use only the highest AP.

warhammer-40k.rule.armour-values-do-not-.cost_or_limit: Overlapping armour provides no additive protection.
warhammer-40k.rule.armour-values-do-not-.blocked_reason: This is a direct rule for choosing armour protection.

warhammer-40k.rule.poor-armour-penalty.name: Poor armour penalty

effect.summary: Poorly made armour gives its wearer –10 to Agility Tests.

warhammer-40k.rule.poor-armour-penalty.blocked_reason: The rule is a direct test modifier.

warhammer-40k.rule.good-armour-quality.name: Good armour quality

effect.summary: Good armour adds one AP against the first attack each round.

warhammer-40k.rule.good-armour-quality.cost_or_limit: Bonus applies only to the first attack in a round.
warhammer-40k.rule.good-armour-quality.blocked_reason: The rule adds a direct armour modifier.

warhammer-40k.rule.best-armour-quality.name: Best armour quality

effect.summary: Best armour weighs half as much and adds one AP.

warhammer-40k.rule.best-armour-quality.blocked_reason: The rule directly adjusts weight and AP.

warhammer-40k.rule.excessive-drug-use.name: Excessive Drug Use

effect.summary: Repeated doses can produce immunity.

warhammer-40k.rule.excessive-drug-use.cost_or_limit: After the first dose in 24 hours, each further use requires a Toughness Test with cumulative –20 penalty.
warhammer-40k.rule.excessive-drug-use.go_wrong: Failure makes the dose ineffective and prevents further effects for 24 hours.
warhammer-40k.rule.excessive-drug-use.combines: Applies to repeated use of the same drug.
warhammer-40k.rule.excessive-drug-use.blocked_reason: This is a basic use limit and failure condition.

warhammer-40k.rule.aigiarn-bridge-baton-.name: Aigiarn bridge-baton ritual

effect.summary: The bridge baton must be ceremonially reinserted with the proper phrases at each shift change.

warhammer-40k.rule.aigiarn-bridge-baton-.cost_or_limit: The shift-change ritual must be performed correctly.
warhammer-40k.rule.aigiarn-bridge-baton-.go_wrong: Failure locks down all command systems to deter piracy or mutiny.
warhammer-40k.rule.aigiarn-bridge-baton-.combines: Uses code-prayers stored in the bridge baton.
warhammer-40k.rule.aigiarn-bridge-baton-.blocked_reason: The rule links an item and ritual to the state of ship-wide command systems.

warhammer-40k.rule.mechadendrite-capacit.name: Mechadendrite capacity

effect.summary: A character's maximum mounted Mechadendrites equal their Toughness Bonus.

warhammer-40k.rule.mechadendrite-capacit.cost_or_limit: The number of mounted Mechadendrites cannot exceed Toughness Bonus.
warhammer-40k.rule.mechadendrite-capacit.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward numerical limit.

warhammer-40k.rule.installing-bionics-an.name: Installing bionics and implants

effect.summary: Installing an implant requires resources, skilled labour, and usually a suitable medical facility.

warhammer-40k.rule.installing-bionics-an.cost_or_limit: Installation takes at least 2d10 days minus Toughness Bonus days, to a minimum of one day.
warhammer-40k.rule.installing-bionics-an.go_wrong: Tests may result in permanent crippling or Blood Loss.
warhammer-40k.rule.installing-bionics-an.who_may: Characters with access to a willing doctor and appropriate facilities.
warhammer-40k.rule.installing-bionics-an.where_from: Substantial medical facilities and technologically advanced worlds.
warhammer-40k.rule.installing-bionics-an.combines: Medicae or Tech-Use Tests may be required at GM discretion.
warhammer-40k.rule.installing-bionics-an.blocked_reason: This is a basic access, time, and risk rule.

warhammer-40k.rule.bionic-replacement-li.name: Bionic replacement limb damage

effect.summary: Replacement limbs match the host's normal strength and dexterity but add Toughness protection at their location.

warhammer-40k.rule.bionic-replacement-li.cost_or_limit: Adds 2 to Toughness Bonus against hits to the replaced location; damage counts normally.
warhammer-40k.rule.bionic-replacement-li.go_wrong: Bleeding or inappropriate critical results disable the limb; lethal limb criticals retain their full effect.
warhammer-40k.rule.bionic-replacement-li.combines: Critical damage is resolved normally, including lethal effects.
warhammer-40k.rule.bionic-replacement-li.blocked_reason: The rule concerns damage-state handling and location-specific protection.

warhammer-40k.rule.replacement-limb-skil.name: Replacement-limb skill requirement

effect.summary: Extra limbs can perform only tasks the owner already knows how to do.

warhammer-40k.rule.replacement-limb-skil.cost_or_limit: The relevant skill is required to use an implant's associated abilities.
warhammer-40k.rule.replacement-limb-skil.who_may: Characters with replacement limbs or Mechadendrites.
warhammer-40k.rule.replacement-limb-skil.combines: Example: a Medicae Mechadendrite requires Medicae skill for its extra abilities.
warhammer-40k.rule.replacement-limb-skil.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward ability prerequisite.

warhammer-40k.rule.bionic-bonus-stacking.name: Bionic bonus stacking

effect.summary: Bionic bonuses apply only to tests using the relevant limb and do not double for two limbs.

warhammer-40k.rule.bionic-bonus-stacking.cost_or_limit: With two bionic limbs, the bonus applies regardless of which one is used, but is not doubled.
warhammer-40k.rule.bionic-bonus-stacking.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward limit on numerical bonuses.

warhammer-40k.rule.cybernetic-craftsmans.name: Cybernetic craftsmanship

effect.summary: Cybernetic benefits and drawbacks depend on craftsmanship, with Best often matching Good mechanically but appearing more refined.

warhammer-40k.rule.cybernetic-craftsmans.cost_or_limit: Listed availability generally means Common; Mechadendrites default to Good unless stated otherwise.
warhammer-40k.rule.cybernetic-craftsmans.go_wrong: Poor-quality implants can be crude or impairing.
warhammer-40k.rule.cybernetic-craftsmans.combines: Craftsmanship affects implant benefits and drawbacks.
warhammer-40k.rule.cybernetic-craftsmans.blocked_reason: This is a basic quality-based modifier to item effects.

warhammer-40k.rule.psyker-power-developm.name: Psyker power development

effect.summary: Raw power tends to remain constant after emergence, while training improves its uses.

warhammer-40k.rule.psyker-power-developm.cost_or_limit: Psyker gifts emerge at varying ages and may require a traumatic trigger.
warhammer-40k.rule.psyker-power-developm.go_wrong: Untrained power risks warp temptation and uncontrolled force.
warhammer-40k.rule.psyker-power-developm.blocked_reason: A general progression rule can be handled without adding a new effect.

warhammer-40k.rule.focus-power.name: Focus Power

effect.summary: Psychic techniques begin with a Focus Power action, usually resolved by a test.

warhammer-40k.rule.focus-power.cost_or_limit: Add five to the Focus Power score per Psy Rating; a result of 100 always fails.
warhammer-40k.rule.focus-power.go_wrong: Some tests can invoke psychic phenomena.
warhammer-40k.rule.focus-power.combines: May use Willpower, Psyniscience, or another relevant test.
warhammer-40k.rule.focus-power.blocked_reason: This is a resolution procedure, not a world mechanism.

warhammer-40k.rule.sustaining-multiple-p.name: Sustaining Multiple Powers

effect.summary: Maintaining multiple powers reduces the effective rating of each, and a power reaching zero ends.

warhammer-40k.rule.sustaining-multiple-p.cost_or_limit: Two powers each lose two rating; three each lose three, continuing by number maintained.
warhammer-40k.rule.sustaining-multiple-p.go_wrong: Phenomena become more severe by ten per additional maintained power.
warhammer-40k.rule.sustaining-multiple-p.blocked_reason: The rule is a direct limit and modifier on maintained powers.

warhammer-40k.rule.cumulative-effects.name: Cumulative Effects

effect.summary: Modifiers and benefits from psychic techniques do not stack; only the highest applies.

warhammer-40k.rule.cumulative-effects.cost_or_limit: Only the strongest applicable modifier or benefit counts.
warhammer-40k.rule.cumulative-effects.blocked_reason: This is a direct interaction restriction.

warhammer-40k.rule.discipline-access.name: Discipline access

effect.summary: A psyker needs at least Psy Rating one to access disciplines and normally may access no more than three.

warhammer-40k.rule.discipline-access.cost_or_limit: Special circumstances or GM discretion may permit additional disciplines.
warhammer-40k.rule.discipline-access.blocked_reason: This is a direct eligibility and limit rule.

warhammer-40k.rule.psychic-phenomena.name: Psychic Phenomena

effect.summary: Warp energy may bleed into reality and produce unpredictable local effects, from eerie signs to a warp breach.

warhammer-40k.rule.psychic-phenomena.cost_or_limit: Unfettered or stronger use risks phenomena; pushing always triggers a check.
warhammer-40k.rule.psychic-phenomena.go_wrong: Effects may be destructive, damaging, or catastrophic.
warhammer-40k.rule.psychic-phenomena.mind: Some manifestations cause fear, confusion, or mental harm.
warhammer-40k.rule.psychic-phenomena.who_may: Psykers using powers at risky strength.
warhammer-40k.rule.psychic-phenomena.combines: Severe results can lead to Perils of the Warp.
warhammer-40k.rule.psychic-phenomena.blocked_reason: The rule generates a broad random range of changing, harmful effects.

warhammer-40k.rule.astrotelepathic-signa.name: Astrotelepathic Signals

effect.summary: Signal travel time, range, required rating, and test difficulty depend on distance.

warhammer-40k.rule.astrotelepathic-signa.cost_or_limit: Longer distances require higher Psy Rating and more time; signals may degrade beyond clear range.
warhammer-40k.rule.astrotelepathic-signa.go_wrong: Warp storms can worsen transmission and reception.
warhammer-40k.rule.astrotelepathic-signa.combines: Relays and choir members can improve transmission.
warhammer-40k.rule.astrotelepathic-signa.blocked_reason: Interstellar signal timing, distance brackets, relays, and degradation exceed the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.psychic-techniques-an.name: Psychic Techniques and Psychic Powers equivalence

effect.summary: Treats psychic techniques and psychic powers as the same for rules interactions.

warhammer-40k.rule.psychic-techniques-an.cost_or_limit: Resistance against either category applies to both.
warhammer-40k.rule.psychic-techniques-an.where_from: Rogue Trader and Dark Heresy compatibility guidance.
warhammer-40k.rule.psychic-techniques-an.combines: Psychic resistance rules work across both categories.
warhammer-40k.rule.psychic-techniques-an.blocked_reason: The rule changes how powers and resistance abilities interact.

warhammer-40k.rule.psy-rating-equivalenc.name: Psy Rating equivalence

effect.summary: Treats Psy Rating as directly equivalent across the two systems.

warhammer-40k.rule.psy-rating-equivalenc.cost_or_limit: Threshold increases convert roughly four points to one lower Psy Rating.
warhammer-40k.rule.psy-rating-equivalenc.where_from: Rogue Trader and Dark Heresy compatibility guidance.
warhammer-40k.rule.psy-rating-equivalenc.combines: Provides a conversion guideline for threshold-based powers.
warhammer-40k.rule.psy-rating-equivalenc.blocked_reason: The rule can be applied as a numeric conversion.

warhammer-40k.rule.power-roll-bonus-conv.name: Power Roll bonus conversion

effect.summary: Converts each +1 bonus to a Power Roll into +5 on a Focus Power Test.

warhammer-40k.rule.power-roll-bonus-conv.cost_or_limit: Applies to talents and other abilities that grant Power Roll bonuses.
warhammer-40k.rule.power-roll-bonus-conv.where_from: Rogue Trader and Dark Heresy compatibility guidance.
warhammer-40k.rule.power-roll-bonus-conv.combines: Converts one system’s test bonus into the other’s.
warhammer-40k.rule.power-roll-bonus-conv.blocked_reason: The rule is a direct numeric adjustment.

warhammer-40k.rule.untouchable-psy-ratin.name: Untouchable Psy Rating reduction

effect.summary: An Untouchable reduces nearby psykers’ Psy Rating by five.

warhammer-40k.rule.untouchable-psy-ratin.blocked_reason: The rule modifies another character’s power rating based on proximity.

warhammer-40k.rule.daemon-and-warp-entit.name: Daemon and Warp Entity psychic strength

effect.summary: Daemons and Warp Entities use their powers only at Unfettered strength and do not suffer adverse Psychic Phenomena or Perils.

warhammer-40k.rule.daemon-and-warp-entit.cost_or_limit: Applies to creatures with Daemonic or Stuff of Nightmares traits.
warhammer-40k.rule.daemon-and-warp-entit.go_wrong: They may still generate Psychic Phenomena at the GM’s discretion, but are not harmed by them.
warhammer-40k.rule.daemon-and-warp-entit.who_may: Daemons and Warp Entities with the named traits.
warhammer-40k.rule.daemon-and-warp-entit.combines: Constrains power strength and modifies Psychic Phenomena consequences.
warhammer-40k.rule.daemon-and-warp-entit.blocked_reason: The rule alters power strength and immunity to power backlash.

warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-gene-cultiv.name: Navigator gene cultivation

effect.summary: Navigator traits persist through selective breeding and rigorous family screening.

warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-gene-cultiv.cost_or_limit: Houses cultivate the gene across generations; lineage variations may make powers and mutations more prevalent.
warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-gene-cultiv.go_wrong: Altered lineages can increase bodily and mental corruption as a Navigator’s power grows.
warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-gene-cultiv.mind: Navigator gene-coding can contribute to mental as well as bodily corruption.
warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-gene-cultiv.who_may: Navigator Houses control breeding and screening.
warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-gene-cultiv.combines: The gene grants a warp affinity and is associated with the third eye and other mutations.
warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-gene-cultiv.blocked_reason: Changing inherited body traits across generations requires a form and heredity mechanic.

warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-power-advan.name: Navigator power advancement

effect.summary: none

warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-power-advan.cost_or_limit: Experience buys new powers or mastery increases at each Rank; new powers start at Novice.
warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-power-advan.blocked_reason: This is a progression mechanism usable with the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-power-use.name: Navigator power use

effect.summary: none

warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-power-use.cost_or_limit: Requires a characteristic test; usually a Standard Action, with mastery bonuses.
warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-power-use.go_wrong: No Psychic Phenomena or Perils of the Warp can occur from Navigator powers.
warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-power-use.where_from: Innate warp connection and inherited genes
warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-power-use.combines: Willpower and Perception tests are common

warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-psyker-trea.name: Navigator psyker treatment

effect.summary: none

warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-psyker-trea.cost_or_limit: Not psykers by Imperial social classification, but treated as psykers for game effects.
warhammer-40k.rule.navigator-psyker-trea.combines: Weapons, powers, and creatures affecting psykers

warhammer-40k.rule.mutation-resistance-a.name: Mutation resistance and acquisition

effect.summary: none

warhammer-40k.rule.mutation-resistance-a.cost_or_limit: New or improved powers prompt a Toughness test; failure gives a random mutation, while lineage sets starting mutations without a test.
warhammer-40k.rule.mutation-resistance-a.go_wrong: Mutation results are rerolled if duplicated
warhammer-40k.rule.mutation-resistance-a.mind: Some mutations affect mental or social state
warhammer-40k.rule.mutation-resistance-a.where_from: Inherited gene purity and warp exposure
warhammer-40k.rule.mutation-resistance-a.blocked_reason: Mutation entries may permanently transform bodies and add traits.

warhammer-40k.rule.warp-and-real-space-t.name: Warp and real-space time ratio

effect.summary: none

warhammer-40k.rule.warp-and-real-space-t.cost_or_limit: A day in the warp averages twelve days in real space, but the ratio varies by route and turbulence.
warhammer-40k.rule.warp-and-real-space-t.go_wrong: Ships can arrive centuries late or, rarely, before departure
warhammer-40k.rule.warp-and-real-space-t.where_from: Different time flow in warp and real space
warhammer-40k.rule.warp-and-real-space-t.blocked_reason: The rule requires variable time passage and possible arrival before departure.

warhammer-40k.rule.warp-translation.name: Warp translation

effect.summary: none

warhammer-40k.rule.warp-translation.cost_or_limit: Entering or leaving the warp is possible without a Navigator, but navigation within it requires guidance or charts.
