warhammer-40k.rule.healing-wounds.blocked_reason: The rule is a direct restoration of vitality over time.

warhammer-40k.rule.gaining-corruption.name: Gaining Corruption

effect.summary: Exposure to Chaos adds Corruption according to its severity, with tests able to reduce the amount gained.

warhammer-40k.rule.gaining-corruption.cost_or_limit: Resistance reduces gained Corruption by success levels, to a minimum of zero.
warhammer-40k.rule.gaining-corruption.go_wrong: Accumulating enough Corruption risks profound bodily or mental change.
warhammer-40k.rule.gaining-corruption.mind: Corruption can affect either body or mind.
warhammer-40k.rule.gaining-corruption.who_may: People exposed to Chaos, its servants, or its designs.
warhammer-40k.rule.gaining-corruption.combines: Fortitude or Discipline can resist; physical influences usually use Fortitude, spiritual ones Discipline.
warhammer-40k.rule.gaining-corruption.blocked_reason: The rule explicitly tracks corruption of the soul, beyond the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.succumbing-to-corrupt.name: Succumbing to Corruption

effect.summary: Corruption above the combined Willpower and Toughness bonuses triggers a later test; failure profoundly changes body or mind.

warhammer-40k.rule.succumbing-to-corrupt.cost_or_limit: The threshold is Willpower Bonus plus Toughness Bonus; the test occurs during the next adventure.
warhammer-40k.rule.succumbing-to-corrupt.go_wrong: Failure causes unnatural transformation or mental change.
warhammer-40k.rule.succumbing-to-corrupt.mind: Failure can profoundly change the psyche.
warhammer-40k.rule.succumbing-to-corrupt.who_may: Characters whose Corruption exceeds the threshold.
warhammer-40k.rule.succumbing-to-corrupt.combines: A successful Fortitude or Discipline test delays the consequence until further Corruption is gained.
warhammer-40k.rule.succumbing-to-corrupt.blocked_reason: The outcome can alter body or mind in unspecified ways, including lasting mutations not represented by the basic grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.minor-exposure.name: MINOR EXPOSURE

effect.summary: Listed minor Chaos exposures add one Corruption before resistance.

warhammer-40k.rule.minor-exposure.go_wrong: Repeated exposure can lead to corruption and transformation.
warhammer-40k.rule.minor-exposure.mind: May contribute to mental and spiritual corruption.
warhammer-40k.rule.minor-exposure.where_from: Daemon sightings, profane texts, Chaos-tainted contact, intense Chaos-linked emotions, or prolonged proximity to Chaos worship sites.
warhammer-40k.rule.minor-exposure.combines: Can be reduced by a Fortitude or Discipline test.
warhammer-40k.rule.minor-exposure.blocked_reason: Corruption is represented as an alteration to the soul.

warhammer-40k.rule.moderate-exposure.name: MODERATE EXPOSURE

effect.summary: Moderate Chaos exposure adds two Corruption before resistance.

warhammer-40k.rule.moderate-exposure.mind: May contribute to mental and spiritual corruption.
warhammer-40k.rule.moderate-exposure.where_from: The specific examples begin beyond the supplied passage’s visible text.
warhammer-40k.rule.moderate-exposure.combines: Can be reduced by a Fortitude or Discipline test.
warhammer-40k.rule.moderate-exposure.blocked_reason: Corruption is represented as an alteration to the soul.

warhammer-40k.rule.major-exposure.name: MAJOR EXPOSURE

effect.summary: Major Chaos exposure adds four Corruption before resistance.

warhammer-40k.rule.major-exposure.go_wrong: Prolonged exposure may cause profound corruption.
warhammer-40k.rule.major-exposure.mind: May contribute to mental and spiritual corruption.
warhammer-40k.rule.major-exposure.where_from: Greater Daemon, prolonged daemon or profane artefact contact, a daemon bargain, or prolonged warp exposure.
warhammer-40k.rule.major-exposure.combines: Can be reduced by a Fortitude or Discipline test.
warhammer-40k.rule.major-exposure.blocked_reason: Corruption is represented as an alteration to the soul.

warhammer-40k.rule.witch-mark.name: Witch-mark

effect.summary: A Chaos-associated mark appears at a randomly determined body location.

warhammer-40k.rule.witch-mark.cost_or_limit: Occurs on a roll of 01–05; location uses the hit-location table.
warhammer-40k.rule.witch-mark.go_wrong: Marks the body with Chaos symbolism.
warhammer-40k.rule.witch-mark.blocked_reason: The basic grammar does not cover creating a lasting bodily mutation.

warhammer-40k.rule.wasted-frame.name: Wasted Frame

effect.summary: The body becomes wasted and pallid, reducing Toughness and increasing the XP cost of certain Advances.

warhammer-40k.rule.wasted-frame.cost_or_limit: Toughness permanently falls by 10; Athletics or Fortitude Advances cost double XP.
warhammer-40k.rule.wasted-frame.blocked_reason: The mutation changes body form and character statistics over time.

warhammer-40k.rule.inhuman-beauty.name: Inhuman Beauty

effect.summary: The skin becomes unnaturally flawless and improves Fellowship when the face is visible.

warhammer-40k.rule.inhuman-beauty.cost_or_limit: Fellowship gains 10 while the face is visible.
warhammer-40k.rule.inhuman-beauty.blocked_reason: The lasting bodily transformation is outside the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.iron-skin.name: Iron Skin

effect.summary: Metal scales or ore form on the body, increasing armour but reducing Agility.

warhammer-40k.rule.iron-skin.cost_or_limit: Adds two Armour to all locations and permanently reduces Agility by 10.
warhammer-40k.rule.iron-skin.blocked_reason: The effect creates a lasting alteration to bodily form.

warhammer-40k.rule.extra-mouth.name: Extra Mouth

effect.summary: An additional mouth appears at a random location and may whisper or scream on its own.

warhammer-40k.rule.extra-mouth.cost_or_limit: Location is determined with the hit-location table.
warhammer-40k.rule.extra-mouth.go_wrong: The mouth can act independently and make disturbing sounds.
warhammer-40k.rule.extra-mouth.mind: The mutation can produce unbidden speech.
warhammer-40k.rule.extra-mouth.blocked_reason: It creates a lasting bodily mutation with autonomous behavior.

warhammer-40k.rule.living-shadow.name: Living Shadow

effect.summary: The character’s shadow moves independently and remains visible regardless of lighting.

warhammer-40k.rule.living-shadow.cost_or_limit: In darkness when the shadow cannot be seen, the character feels it is doing something terrible.
warhammer-40k.rule.living-shadow.go_wrong: Causes persistent dread when the shadow is unseen.
warhammer-40k.rule.living-shadow.mind: Creates an unshakeable feeling of threat.
warhammer-40k.rule.living-shadow.combines: The effect is especially unsettling in darkness.
warhammer-40k.rule.living-shadow.blocked_reason: It imposes a persistent, unshakeable mental state.

warhammer-40k.rule.swollen-brute.name: Swollen Brute

effect.summary: The character becomes greatly enlarged and gains Advantage on opposed Athletics tests.

warhammer-40k.rule.swollen-brute.cost_or_limit: Advantage applies to opposed Athletics tests.
warhammer-40k.rule.swollen-brute.blocked_reason: The lasting body transformation is not expressible by the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.twisted-horns.name: Twisted Horns

effect.summary: Bony horns grow from the head and improve unarmed attacks made with them.

warhammer-40k.rule.twisted-horns.cost_or_limit: Horn attacks lack the Ineffective trait.
warhammer-40k.rule.twisted-horns.blocked_reason: The mutation creates a lasting bodily transformation.

warhammer-40k.rule.daemonic-visage.name: Daemonic Visage

effect.summary: The character becomes bestial or abhorrent, harming Fellowship but improving Intimidation.

warhammer-40k.rule.daemonic-visage.cost_or_limit: Minus two success levels on Fellowship tests in view; Intimidation Rapport tests instead gain two.
warhammer-40k.rule.daemonic-visage.go_wrong: Other people react negatively to the character’s visible face.
warhammer-40k.rule.daemonic-visage.blocked_reason: The lasting bodily transformation is not expressible by the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.digitigrade-legs.name: Digitigrade Legs

effect.summary: The legs become muscular and digitigrade, granting Advantage on athletic movement tests.

warhammer-40k.rule.digitigrade-legs.cost_or_limit: Advantage applies to running, leaping, and other tests using the legs.
warhammer-40k.rule.digitigrade-legs.combines: Improves Athletics tests involving the legs.
warhammer-40k.rule.digitigrade-legs.blocked_reason: The mutation makes a lasting change to body form.

warhammer-40k.rule.feathers.name: Feathers

effect.summary: Feathers grow in patches at two randomly determined body locations.

warhammer-40k.rule.feathers.cost_or_limit: Two locations are rolled; feathers may be any colour.
warhammer-40k.rule.feathers.combines: Location is determined with the hit-location table.
warhammer-40k.rule.feathers.blocked_reason: It creates a lasting bodily mutation.

warhammer-40k.rule.photonic-irregularity.name: Photonic Irregularity

effect.summary: The character is absent from mirrors and visual-light video recordings.

warhammer-40k.rule.photonic-irregularity.cost_or_limit: Applies to reflective surfaces and recordings using visible light.
warhammer-40k.rule.photonic-irregularity.go_wrong: The character cannot appear in those images.
warhammer-40k.rule.photonic-irregularity.blocked_reason: The effect conceals the character from specified visual records.

warhammer-40k.rule.festering-wound.name: Festering Wound

effect.summary: A past Critical Wound returns and cannot be healed, leaving one permanently untreated.

warhammer-40k.rule.festering-wound.cost_or_limit: Always counts as one untreated Critical Wound.
warhammer-40k.rule.festering-wound.go_wrong: The wound cannot be healed and may contribute to death from excess untreated Critical Wounds.
warhammer-40k.rule.festering-wound.combines: Interacts with the untreated Critical Wound death threshold.
warhammer-40k.rule.festering-wound.blocked_reason: The permanent, unhealable injury and its ongoing death-threshold interaction need persistent state beyond a basic effect.

warhammer-40k.rule.lolling-tongue.name: Lolling Tongue

effect.summary: The tongue spasms erratically and penalizes tests requiring speech.

warhammer-40k.rule.lolling-tongue.blocked_reason: The effect includes a lasting bodily transformation.

warhammer-40k.rule.fleshmetal.name: Fleshmetal

effect.summary: Armour and cybernetics fuse with the body, can regenerate, and can be repaired using Fortitude.

warhammer-40k.rule.fleshmetal.cost_or_limit: Cannot change armour or add further armour; conventional repair tests have Disadvantage.
warhammer-40k.rule.fleshmetal.go_wrong: Fused equipment cannot be removed or supplemented with more armour.
warhammer-40k.rule.fleshmetal.combines: Fortitude can repair fused items; conventional Tech repair is hindered.
warhammer-40k.rule.fleshmetal.blocked_reason: The mutation binds equipment to the body and changes item repair and replacement rules.

warhammer-40k.rule.warp-regeneration.name: Warp Regeneration

effect.summary: The character regenerates one Wound at the start of each turn and regrows lost limbs after a day.

warhammer-40k.rule.warp-regeneration.cost_or_limit: Fate falls to zero and cannot be regained.
warhammer-40k.rule.warp-regeneration.go_wrong: Permanent Fate loss and inability to recover it.
warhammer-40k.rule.warp-regeneration.blocked_reason: The delayed regrowth of lost limbs requires a bodily transformation not covered by the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.dissolution-of-body-a.name: Dissolution of Body and Mind

effect.summary: A failed resistance test removes Corruption equal to Willpower Bonus, then determines a Mutation or Malignancy by an even-or-odd d10 roll; duplicates are rerolled.

warhammer-40k.rule.dissolution-of-body-a.cost_or_limit: Requires failing a Test to resist Corruption.
warhammer-40k.rule.dissolution-of-body-a.go_wrong: The character gains a Mutation or Malignancy.
warhammer-40k.rule.dissolution-of-body-a.combines: Even d10 results use the Mutations table; odd results use the Malignancies table.
warhammer-40k.rule.dissolution-of-body-a.blocked_reason: Failure causes a lasting character alteration selected from a table.

warhammer-40k.rule.limits-of-the-soul.name: Limits of the Soul

effect.summary: Exceeding the character’s mutation or malignancy threshold means total fall to Chaos and transformation into a Chaos Spawn.

warhammer-40k.rule.limits-of-the-soul.cost_or_limit: Thresholds are Toughness Bonus for mutations and Willpower Bonus for Malignancies.
warhammer-40k.rule.limits-of-the-soul.go_wrong: The soul is lost and the character becomes a GM-controlled Chaos Spawn.
warhammer-40k.rule.limits-of-the-soul.mind: The mind shatters upon falling to Chaos.
warhammer-40k.rule.limits-of-the-soul.where_from: The limits of the soul under Chaos.
warhammer-40k.rule.limits-of-the-soul.combines: Links alteration counts to Chaos Spawn transformation.
warhammer-40k.rule.limits-of-the-soul.blocked_reason: It defines a terminal soul state and permanent replacement of the character.

warhammer-40k.rule.mutation-manifestatio.name: Mutation Manifestation

effect.summary: The severity of the Corruption exposure generally determines whether a mutation develops over weeks or manifests rapidly.

warhammer-40k.rule.mutation-manifestatio.cost_or_limit: Minor exposure takes weeks or months; moderate takes hours or days; major takes seconds or minutes.
warhammer-40k.rule.mutation-manifestatio.combines: The GM uses exposure severity to judge onset.
warhammer-40k.rule.mutation-manifestatio.blocked_reason: It specifies variable onset timing for body-altering mutations.

warhammer-40k.rule.insufficient-vehicle-.name: Insufficient Vehicle Crew

effect.summary: A vehicle with too few crew goes Out of Control if it moved during its last turn.

warhammer-40k.rule.insufficient-vehicle-.cost_or_limit: Applies when remaining crew are insufficient and the vehicle moved last turn.
warhammer-40k.rule.insufficient-vehicle-.go_wrong: The vehicle goes Out of Control.
warhammer-40k.rule.insufficient-vehicle-.combines: Out of Control determines subsequent movement and crash effects.

warhammer-40k.rule.vehicle-passengers.name: Vehicle Passengers

effect.summary: Vehicle passenger capacity counts additional Size Medium creatures, and some passengers may serve as crew.

warhammer-40k.rule.vehicle-passengers.cost_or_limit: Capacity is specified by each vehicle profile.
warhammer-40k.rule.vehicle-passengers.combines: Some passengers may operate the vehicle when needed.

warhammer-40k.rule.group-endeavours.name: Group Endeavours

effect.summary: A group task cannot succeed if any party member declines to participate.

warhammer-40k.rule.group-endeavours.go_wrong: The Endeavour cannot succeed if anyone opts out.

warhammer-40k.rule.campaign-of-whispers.name: Campaign of Whispers

effect.summary: A successful group effort can raise or lower the Patron’s Influence with a chosen faction.

warhammer-40k.rule.campaign-of-whispers.cost_or_limit: Requires access to influential faction members and a Hard Group Persuasion Test of Complexity 6.
warhammer-40k.rule.campaign-of-whispers.go_wrong: Repeated attempts to discredit the Patron may expose the betrayal and cause ruinous consequences.
warhammer-40k.rule.campaign-of-whispers.combines: May improve or damage the Patron’s reputation.

warhammer-40k.rule.combat-training.name: Combat Training

effect.summary: The party can begin one combat encounter in the next adventure with +1 Superiority.

warhammer-40k.rule.combat-training.cost_or_limit: Applies to one encounter in the next adventure.

warhammer-40k.rule.bolster-defences.name: Bolster Defences

effect.summary: Improves the party’s base defence, granting Superiority if it is raided or boarded.

warhammer-40k.rule.bolster-defences.cost_or_limit: Repeated use grants at most +3 Superiority.
warhammer-40k.rule.bolster-defences.go_wrong: Mission events may degrade the defences.
warhammer-40k.rule.bolster-defences.who_may: A party with a primary base.
warhammer-40k.rule.bolster-defences.combines: Applies to raids on a base or boarding of a voidship.

warhammer-40k.rule.speculation.name: Speculation

effect.summary: Invested Solars may grow by a chosen percentage or be entirely lost based on a later roll.

warhammer-40k.rule.speculation.cost_or_limit: Choose a risk number from 1 to 20; withdrawal requires a Commerce Endeavour.
warhammer-40k.rule.speculation.go_wrong: A roll at or below the chosen number loses the full investment.
warhammer-40k.rule.speculation.combines: The next Between Missions roll determines success or loss.

warhammer-40k.rule.consolidate-influence.name: Consolidate Influence

effect.summary: Influence from three Contacts of one Faction can be consolidated into increased faction standing.

warhammer-40k.rule.consolidate-influence.cost_or_limit: Requires at least +1 Influence with three Contacts in the same Faction; personal faction Influence normally caps at +3.
warhammer-40k.rule.consolidate-influence.go_wrong: A Fumble reduces Influence with one Contact.
warhammer-40k.rule.consolidate-influence.combines: A successful Rapport Test raises faction Influence while reducing each chosen Contact’s Influence.

warhammer-40k.rule.crafting-materials-an.name: Crafting Materials and Completion

effect.summary: Crafting uses one roll per Endeavour toward an extended test; completed work functions, gains a Flaw on failure, or an extra Quality on critical success.

warhammer-40k.rule.crafting-materials-an.cost_or_limit: Raw materials usually cost one quarter of the item’s listed price; required successes depend on the GM.
warhammer-40k.rule.crafting-materials-an.go_wrong: Failure gives the item a GM-chosen Flaw.
warhammer-40k.rule.crafting-materials-an.combines: Critical success grants one Quality chosen by the character.
warhammer-40k.rule.crafting-materials-an.mechanism: Extended test and item quality outcome

warhammer-40k.rule.psyker-soul-tithe.name: Psyker soul tithe

effect.summary: A thousand psyker souls are consumed each day to sustain the Emperor.

warhammer-40k.rule.psyker-soul-tithe.cost_or_limit: Daily sacrifice of one thousand psykers.
warhammer-40k.rule.psyker-soul-tithe.go_wrong: The Emperor may still die if the Golden Throne fails.
warhammer-40k.rule.psyker-soul-tithe.blocked_reason: This rule requires consuming souls to sustain a being.

warhammer-40k.rule.psyker-vulnerability-.name: Psyker vulnerability to the warp

effect.summary: An unguarded psyker mind can become a tool of daemonic entities.

warhammer-40k.rule.psyker-vulnerability-.go_wrong: Daemonic control and world-scale catastrophe can follow.
warhammer-40k.rule.psyker-vulnerability-.combines: Inquisitors of the Ordo Malleus watch for manifestations.
warhammer-40k.rule.psyker-vulnerability-.blocked_reason: The rule describes external entities taking control of a mind.

warhammer-40k.rule.astropathic-message-i.name: Astropathic message interpretation

effect.summary: Astropathic messages arrive as allegorical, nightmarish visions that require interpretation.

warhammer-40k.rule.astropathic-message-i.mind: Receiving visions can affect the recipient's psyche.
warhammer-40k.rule.astropathic-message-i.combines: Theophania Federov is especially skilled at interpretation.

warhammer-40k.rule.imperial-tithe.name: Imperial tithe

effect.summary: Every Imperial world must provide resources, warriors, or psykers according to its assessed capacity.

warhammer-40k.rule.imperial-tithe.cost_or_limit: The Administratum determines a world's expected contribution.
warhammer-40k.rule.imperial-tithe.go_wrong: Disrupted administration can leave quotas unmet or leaders uncertain.
warhammer-40k.rule.imperial-tithe.who_may: Imperial worlds are subject to the obligation.
warhammer-40k.rule.imperial-tithe.combines: Supplies armies, materials, and psyker sacrifices.

warhammer-40k.rule.immaterium-travel-tim.name: Immaterium travel time shifts

effect.summary: Warp travel makes the actual duration of a journey difficult to establish.

warhammer-40k.rule.immaterium-travel-tim.combines: Makes the crusade’s true length uncertain.
warhammer-40k.rule.immaterium-travel-tim.blocked_reason: The rule is a timing constraint and can be represented without adding a new effect capability.

warhammer-40k.rule.planetary-tariffs.name: Planetary tariffs

effect.summary: Governors commonly impose duties on goods entering or leaving their worlds.

warhammer-40k.rule.planetary-tariffs.cost_or_limit: Tariffs apply to incoming and outgoing goods.
warhammer-40k.rule.planetary-tariffs.blocked_reason: The rule is a cost constraint and requires no unavailable effect capability.

warhammer-40k.rule.psykers-sense-the-gre.name: Psykers sense the Great Rift’s opening

effect.summary: Psykers across the sector immediately perceived the galaxy’s catastrophe.

warhammer-40k.rule.psykers-sense-the-gre.combines: The event coincided with the loss of Astronomican perception.
warhammer-40k.rule.psykers-sense-the-gre.blocked_reason: The passage describes supernatural awareness of a distant event, beyond the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.navigators-cannot-per.name: Navigators cannot perceive the Astronomican

effect.summary: When the Astronomican is imperceptible, Warp travel is immediately constrained.

warhammer-40k.rule.navigators-cannot-per.blocked_reason: This restriction can be represented as a game limitation.

warhammer-40k.rule.the-noctis-aeterna-re.name: The Noctis Aeterna recedes unpredictably

effect.summary: The Warp darkness withdraws from worlds irregularly, sometimes leaving parts of a system afflicted.

warhammer-40k.rule.the-noctis-aeterna-re.go_wrong: Attempts to study it can drive researchers mad.
warhammer-40k.rule.the-noctis-aeterna-re.who_may: It affects worlds in the sector.
warhammer-40k.rule.the-noctis-aeterna-re.combines: Its movement follows unknowable Warp tides.
warhammer-40k.rule.the-noctis-aeterna-re.blocked_reason: The effect is a persistent, irregular condition over multiple worlds.

warhammer-40k.rule.valios-highborn-filte.name: Valios Highborn filter data with cranial implants

effect.summary: Advanced implants let Highborn rapidly process the hive’s data streams mentally.

warhammer-40k.rule.valios-highborn-filte.cost_or_limit: The passage states no specific cost.
warhammer-40k.rule.valios-highborn-filte.mind: Data streams are processed by the mind.
warhammer-40k.rule.valios-highborn-filte.combines: Compared to the Logi of the Cult Mechanicus.
warhammer-40k.rule.valios-highborn-filte.blocked_reason: The described information processing can be represented with the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.emergency-rendering-o.name: Emergency rendering of serious criminals

effect.summary: An ancient provision permits a senior Administratum official to condemn serious criminals for sustenance in dire emergencies.

warhammer-40k.rule.emergency-rendering-o.cost_or_limit: Requires a senior Administratum member, serious crimes, and dire emergency.

warhammer-40k.rule.vellum-cooking-senten.name: Vellum cooking sentencing

effect.summary: Clerks were sentenced to death for devising a way to cook and eat vellum, because records might be destroyed.

warhammer-40k.rule.vellum-cooking-senten.cost_or_limit: The act threatens potentially vital records.

warhammer-40k.rule.illisear-s-population.name: Illisear’s population attracts Warp attention

effect.summary: Greater concentrations of people on Illisear appear to attract dangerous Warp entities.

warhammer-40k.rule.illisear-s-population.cost_or_limit: Maintaining large forces is consequently ill-advised.
warhammer-40k.rule.illisear-s-population.go_wrong: Nameless things may attack and kill inhabitants.

warhammer-40k.rule.macharia-s-stable-war.name: Macharia’s stable warp routes

effect.summary: The warp remains unusually stable across vast distances around Macharia, providing many stable routes.

warhammer-40k.rule.macharia-s-stable-war.cost_or_limit: The cause is not explained; Ecclesiarchy attributes it to Saint Macharius’s body.
warhammer-40k.rule.macharia-s-stable-war.combines: Enabled supply routes during Macharius’s campaigns.

warhammer-40k.rule.maleer-s-apparent-gra.name: Maleer’s apparent gravity anomaly

effect.summary: Measured gravity exceeds Terran standard, yet native life behaves as if gravity were lower, enabling enormous bodies and flight.

warhammer-40k.rule.maleer-s-apparent-gra.combines: May account for oversized fauna and their flight.

warhammer-40k.rule.bone-derived-metal-in.name: Bone-derived metal in Knight repairs

effect.summary: Metal-bearing compounds from giant-beast bones are used to repair Knight armour.

warhammer-40k.rule.bone-derived-metal-in.cost_or_limit: Requires suitable dense bones from large slain creatures.
warhammer-40k.rule.bone-derived-metal-in.go_wrong: The practice is considered borderline heretical by Mechanicus visitors.
warhammer-40k.rule.bone-derived-metal-in.combines: Used to repair the house’s Knights.

warhammer-40k.rule.hypno-indoctrination-.name: hypno-indoctrination and face-melding surgeries

effect.summary: A Hronis family member is conditioned and surgically altered to impersonate the ruling matriarch.

warhammer-40k.rule.hypno-indoctrination-.cost_or_limit: Extensive conditioning and surgery are used.
warhammer-40k.rule.hypno-indoctrination-.mind: Rewrites the subject's conditioning to support the assumed identity.
warhammer-40k.rule.hypno-indoctrination-.combines: Used together to maintain the appearance of one continuous ruler.
warhammer-40k.rule.hypno-indoctrination-.mechanism: replacement identity through conditioning and surgery
warhammer-40k.rule.hypno-indoctrination-.blocked_reason: The lasting imposition of an identity requires mind alteration beyond the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.molecular-level-brand.name: molecular-level branding

effect.summary: Ibal's grown metal bears the purchaser's chosen sigils at the molecular level.

warhammer-40k.rule.molecular-level-brand.cost_or_limit: Branding occurs before the grove is ready for harvest.
warhammer-40k.rule.molecular-level-brand.go_wrong: Stolen material can be traced through later devices.
warhammer-40k.rule.molecular-level-brand.combines: Auditors can track deconstructed devices back through their makers and sellers.
warhammer-40k.rule.molecular-level-brand.blocked_reason: The effect depends on a specific material-property and forensic tracking system not supported by the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.hulvasa-wild-growth-r.name: Hulvasa wild-growth restriction

effect.summary: Hulvasa resists cultivation away from Paleon and must be grown wild.

warhammer-40k.rule.hulvasa-wild-growth-r.cost_or_limit: It cannot reliably be raised on other worlds.
warhammer-40k.rule.hulvasa-wild-growth-r.go_wrong: Attempts elsewhere produce failures and may yield deadly neurotoxins.
warhammer-40k.rule.hulvasa-wild-growth-r.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward restriction on where the plant can grow.

warhammer-40k.rule.hulvasa-longevity-tre.name: Hulvasa longevity treatment

effect.summary: Regular rejuvenat treatment can extend elite lifespans to centuries; hulvasa and augmetics can extend them further.

warhammer-40k.rule.hulvasa-longevity-tre.cost_or_limit: Access is limited and harvesting is dangerous; the passage gives no fixed duration or cost.
warhammer-40k.rule.hulvasa-longevity-tre.go_wrong: The body eventually fails; no other treatment risk is stated.
warhammer-40k.rule.hulvasa-longevity-tre.who_may: Those able to obtain the treatments and, for the longest lifespans, extensive augmetics.
warhammer-40k.rule.hulvasa-longevity-tre.combines: Hulvasa is used with rejuvenat treatment; rarer blooms and augmetics extend longevity further.
warhammer-40k.rule.hulvasa-longevity-tre.blocked_reason: A lifespan increase fits the basic effect grammar.

warhammer-40k.rule.hulvasa-harvest-conje.name: Hulvasa harvest conjecture

effect.summary: House scholars suspect gigantosaurs, or nobles suspect blood-soaked soil, may account for hulvasa’s qualities; neither claim is confirmed.
